chapters.title: Chapter 4080: Fables and Pride! I
paragraphs: The gaze of the Queen of Matter drifted to the Aquarium, where close to a dozen Marine Lifeforms now swam through Early Sacred Waters that shouldn’t have been able to exist outside the Earliest Folds.

Each creature was a masterwork of evolution guided by impossible circumstances...fish that swam through time as easily as water, eels that existed in multiple dimensions simultaneously, something that might have been an octopus if octopi had decided that tentacles were too limiting.
The Sacred Totems stood at their positions like guardians of possibility, each one humming with stored materials and barely contained power.

Heidrun grazed on Singular Prosperity Grass and Auric Vitae Grasses with the casual arrogance of someone who had existed before grass knew it was supposed to be eaten. Each bite seemed to make her more real, more present, as if the grass was teaching her new ways to exist.

"Sir Osmont continues to do things that pave the way for the unimaginable," the Queen of Matter said aloud, her words being recorded even as she spoke them. "In all this grandeur...this impossible, improbable, absolutely absurd grandeur...I’m glad to be part of it. Even if I’m just a footnote on a single page of this grand Fable."

She sighed with happiness that transcended simple contentment. To be part of a story still being written, to watch legend being crafted in real-time...what greater purpose could a Record Keeper ask for?

A shift in the air behind her made her awareness spike. Temperature dropped and rose simultaneously as shadows gathered in ways that suggested they had always been there. A figure wrapped in darkness and frost materialized with the particular grace of someone who had made friends with contradiction.
The Queen of Matter turned with a smile that suggested this was expected, welcome, routine.

"Oh, Shadow Guard Night! Help me record the most recent Fable! THE Living Order has just dragged one of Sir Osmont’s bodies into the Abode for what she called ’a different kind of Order,’ and I need someone to help me speculate wildly about what that might mean!"

Night emerged more fully from her wrapping of shadows, ice crystals forming in the air around her despite the Shore’s warmth. Her expression remained unreadable, but something in her posture suggested amusement.
"Should we be recording such private matters?" Night’s voice carried the whisper of winter wind through empty halls.

"Everything is Fable," the Queen of Matter replied with certainty that asked for no argument. "The grand battles and the quiet moments, the existential achievements and the personal entanglements. Sir Osmont’s story isn’t just about power...it’s about the people that power brings together."

Night considered this, then nodded slowly. "Then we should note that the Shore seems particularly vibrant today. As if it approves of its Master finding more happiness. Or maybe just the inclusion of THE Living Order..."

They were right. The Early Veiled Shore buzzed with life and possibility that transcended its normal vibrancy. Every plant grew a little taller, every wave sparkled a little brighter, every grain of sand seemed a little more golden.
At the Shore’s center, two Seeds commanded attention through their mere existence.
The Seed of Inevitability pulsed with power that suggested it was moments away from blooming, its nature still undecided but its potential unlimited.

Beside it, the Seed of the Principle of Perpetual Harvest glowed with satisfaction of purpose achieved. It had been planted by the First Farmer, failed for eons, and finally found success through the Infiniverse’s sacrifice and transformation. Now it stood as testament that even failure could be harvested for future success.
The Shore was many things...sanctuary, fortress, farm, home. But more than any of these, it was proof that impossibility was just possibility that hadn’t been properly motivated yet.

Inside the Abode, Order was being imposed in ways that would remain private. Outside, life continued in its beautifully chaotic way, each being pursuing their own purposes while contributing to the greater whole.

And somewhere in the Primordial Early Excavation Depths, other bodies of Noah and Sigrid, and Moiraine for that matter, continued their delving, very much aware that their other selves were engaged in very different forms of exploration.
Such was life in the Early Veiled Shore...multiple things happening simultaneously, each thread weaving into an existence that no single perspective could fully appreciate.

The Queen of Matter opened her golden book and began writing, her words capturing not just events but the feeling of them, the weight of them, the beautiful absurdity of beings powerful enough to reshape existence choosing to spend their time on things as wonderfully mundane as relationships.
"Chapter 5,731," she spoke as she wrote. "In which Order discovers that some chaos requires hands-on management..."
Night blinked as she shook her head. "You...aren’t writing your own fanfictions again, are you? If Sir finds out..."

The Queen of Matter instantly grabbed Night’s mouth white looking around. With stern eyes, she spoke out. "Don’t speak loudly about this! Okay?! I’ll lend you the rare possible Fable of the Rank A Hunter, Elizabeth of the Blessed Empire from Sir’s Homeworld..."
Night laughed as she shook her head, and the Shore continued its endless dance of growth, harvest, and possibility!
In an extremely far distance.
The Desiccated Sleeping Shore stretched like a monument to endings.
Where other Shores sang with life and possibility, this one whispered of what happened when existence forgot to continue.
The sands weren’t golden but grey-white, like ash that had forgotten it once was fire. No waters lapped at these beaches...only dried beds where oceans had given up on being wet!

Alexander stepped out from a swirling multicolored portal at this moment. In his arms carried princess style, held with the particular care reserved for precious things that might break, was Seraphina Valorheart.
She breathed heavily, each inhalation carrying the weight of overexertion.
Her usually immaculate form showed signs of strain...hair disheveled, flushed cheeks...
Whatever they had done, wherever they had been, had pushed even her considerable capabilities to their limits!

chapters.title: Chapter 4081: Fables and Pride! II
paragraphs: Alexander himself bore marks of the journey. His chest was laid bare, the fabric of his upper garment having been sacrificed to something that left no remains.
His toned muscles gleamed with perspiration that contained traces of conceptual effort.
Upon his chest, his Enneagram blazed brighter than ever, its nine points connected by lines that seemed to pulse with heartbeat rhythm.

Near the bisected head of an Early Creature that served as this Shore’s most prominent landmark, two figures waited. Royal Law Tristesse stood with the patience of someone who had learned that rushing Law only made it contrary. Beside her, Kaedric observed with high expectations!
Tristesse sighed as she watched Alexander’s careful handling of Seraphina.
"Were you successful?" The question emerged with weight that suggested entire futures hung on the answer.
Alexander’s gaze turned cold as he nodded once.
"Yes. I know where the Early Tool of THE Living Law is." He paused, adjusting his hold on Seraphina as she stirred slightly.
"But if anyone other than me and Seraphina approach it, the Tool will disappear across Folds and time. Perhaps permanently. You two will have to stay behind."
The words landed with finality that made even the dead Shore seem more lifeless!
Royal Law Tristesse’s eyes burned with expectations and possibilities, her mind clearly racing through implications, calculating probabilities, weighing costs against potential gains.
When she spoke, she seemed to have thought of something else entirely as she was thoughtful.
"Do you know what the Chronicles of Judgment say about THE Living Law’s Tools?"

She used the formal name...the Chronicles of Judgment, the record that Living Laws had maintained since the Earliest Folds, documenting the Laws that governed them, the precedents that shaped existence’s rules.

"Only Dukes of Law and Royal Living Laws can read the deepest sections, the parts that record THE Living Law’s direct interventions." Her voice grew distant, as if reading from memory that transcended simple recollection.
"There’s a story there, ancient even by our standards."
She moved slightly.

"A terrifying Fold Dweller approached THE Living Law with a question that contained accusation. ’Has THE Creature abandoned us?’ the Fold Dweller asked. ’Are you the only one maintaining order now? The only one who cares whether existence has structure?’"
Tristesse’s expression grew complex, mixing reverence with something that might have been fear.

"THE Living Law’s response was characteristically indirect: ’Do not think of matters that do not concern you or others. Through me, through my Tools, through my Weapons, prosperity will be ensured across all Folds. Structure will be maintained. Order will prevail.’"
She paused, letting the weight of those words settle.
"And then THE Living Law did something unprecedented. It gave this Fold Dweller an Early Tool...the Scale of Equilibrium’s Reckoning."
The name itself seemed to make the air heavier, as if existence recognized something significant being invoked.

"According to the Chronicles, the Scale could weigh not just physical matter but concepts themselves. Justice against mercy. Order against chaos. Even existence against void. Whatever was placed upon its pans would be measured against absolute truth, and the lighter concept would be... corrected. Made heavier through enforcement, or removed entirely if it couldn’t bear the weight of existence."
HUUM!
Her gaze grew intense as she continued.

"THE Living Law told the Fold Dweller to use it to balance any chaos. To discipline Early Creatures and Living Existences if necessary. To ensure that power never grew so absolute that it forgot its responsibilities."
Royal Law Tristesse looked at Alexander and Seraphina with eyes that had made their decision. The stern set of her features suggested this choice had been weighed and found necessary.
"Go." The single word carried more authority than lengthy commands could have.

"If you can obtain any Tool of THE Living Law...whether the Scale or something else, it will be a boon for all Living Laws. We have existed too long on precedent alone. An actual Tool would change many things..."
Alexander studied her for a moment, perhaps weighing her sincerity against necessity. Then he nodded simply!
Without further words, he began walking toward the bisected head of the Early Creature.
Each step seemed purposeful, as if following a path only he could see. The Enneagram on his chest began to pulse brighter, its light synchronizing with something.
As he drew closer, it became clear that Seraphina also bore an Enneagram on her chest that was shining the same manner!
Together, they created a resonance that made the dead Shore remember it had once been alive!

The bisected head of the Early Creature...massive even in death, even split in half...began to respond with recognition. The two Enneagrams weren’t just symbols or sources of power...they were keys, and the Desiccated Sleeping Shore was a lock that had been waiting eons to be opened!
The air grew thick with possibility. The grey-white sands began to swirl despite the absence of wind. The dried ocean beds cracked in patterns.
Three seconds passed. Four. Five.
BOOM!

The explosion was transitional...the sound of space deciding to be somewhere else. Where Alexander and Seraphina had stood, only disturbed sand remained. They hadn’t traveled in any conventional sense...they had been admitted, accepted, allowed entry to something that existed perpendicular to normal reality.
Royal Law Tristesse and Kaedric remained on the Desiccated Sleeping Shore, the sudden absence of their companions making the desolation more pronounced.
Tristesse’s demeanor shifted immediately from contemplative to commanding!
The historian transformed into the Royal Law she was, authority radiating from her form like heat from forge-fired metal.
"Come," she said to Kaedric, her voice seeking no delay. "We must prepare for the Kleos Concordat. Every Law must be ready and every possible argument anticipated."
She began moving with purpose that transformed walking into declaration.
"If they return with a Tool before then..." She let the sentence hang, but the implications were clear.
A Tool of THE Living Law would shift many things.
Kaedric followed, his own thoughts clearly racing through possibilities. "Do you think they’ll succeed?"
Tristesse considered the question with the weight it deserved. "Who the fuck knows man, we are all just trying everything we can..."

chapters.title: Chapter 4082: Fables and Pride! III
paragraphs: She paused at the edge of the Shore, where a portal awaited to return them to the Doorway to the Loom.
“But...if anyone can retrieve something THE Living Law left behind, it would be them. come on!”
Weavings of existence continued to unfold across the Folds.
There were countless Fables and countless players, with some not knowing just how terrifying the Folds of others could be.
While some sought Tools of THE Living Law in distant realms, others pursued something more fundamental!
Not artifacts of power, but power itself, and the knowledge of how existence could be transcended.
In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, there existed a region that defied even paradoxical standards.
Dozens of obsidian rivers flowed here, but they followed no conventional physics...some ran upward, others sideways, several flowed through themselves in loops that had no beginning or end.
The waters weren’t water but liquidified contradiction, each drop containing the statement “this does not exist” while very clearly existing!
At the center of these impossible waterways stood Schrodinger in his characteristic beggar’s appearance, though what surrounded him suggested anything but poverty of power.
Five Inevitabilities lay still around him.
Not dormant, not waiting....truly still, in the way only dead things could achieve.
These were the same Inevitabilities he had imprisoned in the Doorway to the Loom, the ones that had devoured part of THE Living Order’s Everything.
Now their countless tentacles, which had once reached through dimensions to consume meaning itself, lay limp and purposeless!
An Inevitability that was 5 Inevitabilities, killed!
The air thrummed with the terrifying complexity of Paradox that Schrodinger emitted.
He worked with the focused intensity of a surgeon operating on existence itself, his hands moving through the corpse of the nearest Inevitability with purpose that transcended the physical.
He was carving out Everything.
Not the general everything, but the specific Everything that the Inevitability had consumed from THE Living Order!
The process should have been impossible...Everything, once devoured by an Inevitability, may be gone forever, processed into nothing.
May be.
Yet here was Schrodinger, carefully extracting what shouldn’t exist from something that barely existed itself.
Behind him, the paradoxical rivers suddenly parted like curtains made of impossibility.
Through the gap floated Duke Diviticus, moving with the caution of someone entering a space they knew they survived only through sufferance!
Schrodinger had sensed her approach and allowed it...without his permission, the rivers would have drowned her in contradictions that even her Duke-level existence couldn’t reconcile.

“I did not mean offense before,” she said immediately, her usual arrogance replaced with something approaching humility. “I am patient...I’m trying to be. I’m just attempting to be like you. To reach your height, your power, your understanding of what Paradox truly means.”
Schrodinger continued his work as she spoke, his hands never pausing in their extraction.
When he finally responded, his voice carried the weight of someone who had seen too much to be impressed by ambition alone.

“It might be possible with enough work.” He paused, adjusting his grip on something that wasn’t quite matter but wasn’t quite concept. “But what I seek to do is something that not many will understand. The path I walk isn’t about power in the traditional sense.”
He turned slightly, fixing her with eyes that contained depths of paradox that made her Duke-level perception struggle.
“Do you... wish to know an utterly abysmal secret? Something revealed to me by something even I still do not fully understand?”
The question hung between them with weight!
Diviticus floated closer, her entire being focused on this moment. When she spoke, the single word carried desperation that transcended simple curiosity.
“Please.”
Schrodinger smiled as his voicd echoed out.

“During an extremely low point in my existence, I floated across the Earliest Folds in despair. I wasn’t seeking anything...I was seeking nothing. Release. An end to the constant struggle of maintaining paradox in an existence that insisted on resolution.”
He returned to his work, but his voice continued, painting pictures with words.
“In that state, approaching the kind of nothing that even Paradox fears, I heard a voice. It said...’I sense a vibrant light wishing to dwindle.’
The voice likely stemmed from one of THE Living Existences...though even that is conjecture as even I do not know for sure. I cannot say for certain what spoke to me that day.”
His hands moved through the Inevitability’s form with practiced precision as he continued.

“I responded with the desperation of someone who had tried everything and found it all wanting. ‘What is it all for?’ I asked. ‘Nothing seems to work. There is never enough power. Fold Dwellers, Living Existences, even Paradoxes...the vast majority of life will never reach the grandeur of THE Living Existences or THE Creature. It is all... for naught.'”
Silence settled over them, broken only by the sound of extraction that shouldn’t have a sound.
Schrodinger’s work continued as he picked up.
“The voice laughed...not cruelly, but with the mockery of someone explaining why water is wet to someone drowning.
‘Of course you could never reach them,’ it said. ‘They have grasped an entirely different Scale of Existence compared to you.'”
BOOM!
Diviticus leaned forward, her entire being focused on what came next.

“The voice explained something that reframed everything I thought I knew,” Schrodinger continued. “It spoke of the Vakochev Scale of Civilizational Existence. Deemed so by someone who theorized that existential civilization wasn’t about numbers, or tools, or magic, or technology, but about the relationship between oneself and existence’s fundamental architecture.”
He paused his extraction, his expression growing grave.

“Here’s the truly abysmal part- You, me... every being we know...we aren’t even civilized enough to be given a ranking on this scale. We exist at what is known as Level Zero...Pre-Civilizational Existence.”
Diviticus recoiled slightly at this, but Schrodinger continued relentlessly.

“Level Zero is where we can meaningfully affect existence, yes. We can tap into the energy of reality, manipulate local Folds, even begin grasping and reaching out unsuccessfully at tools that tip the scales...Principles, the manipulation of Everythings.... But we’re still operating within weavings rather than upon it. We’re complex enough to do many things, but we’re essentially sophisticated animals in a zoo we don’t even know exists. Uncivilized. Weak. Fucking laughable.”
His voice...dripped with immense pain and hatred when he said this- and these emotions quickly disappeared!

“It might be possible with enough work.” He paused, adjusting his grip on something that wasn’t quite matter but wasn’t quite concept.
“But what I seek to do is something that not many will understand.
The path I walk isn’t about power in the traditional sense.”
He turned slightly, fixing her with eyes that contained depths of paradox that made her Duke-level perception struggle.
“Do you... wish to know an utterly abysmal secret?
Something revealed to me by something even I still do not fully understand?”
The question hung between them with weight!
Diviticus floated closer, her entire being focused on this moment.
When she spoke, the single word carried desperation that transcended simple curiosity.
“Please.”
Schrodinger smiled as his voicd echoed out.
“During an extremely low point in my existence, I floated across the Earliest Folds in despair.
I wasn’t seeking anything...I was seeking nothing.
Release.
An end to the constant struggle of maintaining paradox in an existence that insisted on resolution.”
He returned to his work, but his voice continued, painting pictures with words.
“In that state, approaching the kind of nothing that even Paradox fears, I heard a voice.
It said...’I sense a vibrant light wishing to dwindle.’
The voice likely stemmed from one of THE Living Existences...though even that is conjecture as even I do not know for sure.
I cannot say for certain what spoke to me that day.”
His hands moved through the Inevitability’s form with practiced precision as he continued.
“I responded with the desperation of someone who had tried everything and found it all wanting.
‘What is it all for?’ I asked.
‘Nothing seems to work.
There is never enough power.
Fold Dwellers, Living Existences, even Paradoxes...the vast majority of life will never reach the grandeur of THE Living Existences or THE Creature.
It is all... for naught.'”
Silence settled over them, broken only by the sound of extraction that shouldn’t have a sound.
Schrodinger’s work continued as he picked up.
“The voice laughed...not cruelly, but with the mockery of someone explaining why water is wet to someone drowning.
‘Of course you could never reach them,’ it said.
‘They have grasped an entirely different Scale of Existence compared to you.'”
BOOM!
Diviticus leaned forward, her entire being focused on what came next.
“The voice explained something that reframed everything I thought I knew,” Schrodinger continued.
“It spoke of the Vakochev Scale of Civilizational Existence.

Deemed so by someone who theorized that existential civilization wasn’t about numbers, or tools, or magic, or technology, but about the relationship between oneself and existence’s fundamental architecture.”
He paused his extraction, his expression growing grave.
“Here’s the truly abysmal part- You, me... every being we know...we aren’t even civilized enough to be given a ranking on this scale.
We exist at what is known as Level Zero...Pre-Civilizational Existence.”
Diviticus recoiled slightly at this, but Schrodinger continued relentlessly.
“Level Zero is where we can meaningfully affect existence, yes.
We can tap into the energy of reality, manipulate local Folds, even begin grasping and reaching out unsuccessfully at tools that tip the scales...Principles, the manipulation of Everythings....
But we’re still operating within weavings rather than upon it.
We’re complex enough to do many things, but we’re essentially sophisticated animals in a zoo we don’t even know exists.
Uncivilized.
Weak.
Fucking laughable.”
His voice...dripped with immense pain and hatred when he said this- and these emotions quickly disappeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 4083: Fables and Pride! IV
paragraphs: Schrodinger’s face seemed to be dismayed as he continued!
“We are feeble, and do not know anything. We could be eradicated in a few seconds, and we would not even know. It is immense weaknes!”

“It is terrifying as sometimes, I can barely close my eyes. I have not slept for eons as...what if I never wake up? If something like THE Living Paradox simply looked at me and told me to stop existing, and that would be it? To be at this level of Existence...is to be fearful. It is to be weak. And I truly do not wish to be weak!”
HUUM!
He became silent.
His words were heavy as Diviticus could not reply!
But he continued as if regardless of his fear...he had to continue.

“Above that, where THE Living Existences and The Creature are...at a stage where Principles simply flow through them. Everythings are a currency, and they have tapped into weavings of existence we cannot even understand. A level of Civilized Existence we cannot fathom. Ah...”
He shook his head with longing.
Deep, immesurable longing!

Diviticus’s form trembled with the weight of this revelation. “What is the method to reach that scale?! How can we advance?! What is that Scale called? Is...there a level of Existential Civilization after that? After THE Living Existences and THE Creature?!”
A bombardment of questions as Diviticus seemed to be having an existential crisis!
And yet...
Schrodinger shook his head with something that might have been pity.

“You... are too far off to know things like that. The journey from Zero to One requires more than power...it requires fundamental restructuring of how you relate to existence itself. How you tap into Authority, how authority cycles through you, perpetuity...ah”
He shook his head ahead as he breathed out as if to calm himself.
He then gestured to his work. “Come, observe as I take into my being part of what used to be inside THE Living Order.”
The words resonated with terrible certainty.
Schrodinger was extracting something that had been part of THE Living Order’s Everything.

His hands emerged from the bisected Inevitability holding something that hurt to perceive....a fragment of Disorder from Order itself, crystallized into form through paradox. It was black-gold, like solidified authority, pulsing with power!

“This,” Schrodinger said, holding the fragment with reverence that transcended possession, “is what advancement looks like. Not taking power, but understanding what power means. Not ascending through force, but recognizing that the ladder you’re climbing might be leaning against the wrong wall.”

He absorbed the fragment into himself, and for a moment, his beggar’s form flickered...showing something vast, something that existed across multiple weavings simultaneously before collapsing back into humble appearance.
Diviticus watched with awe, horror, and fear combined.
She was witnessing something that shouldn’t be possible!

“The Scale of Civilizational Existence...the Vakochev Scale of Existence isn’t about individual power. It’s about how many of existence’s rules and principles you’re playing by versus how many you’re writing. THE Living Existences write rules and principles. We...are still learning to read them.”
The work continued, surrounded by impossible rivers and watched by someone who was beginning to understand that power, true power, might be something entirely different from what she had imagined!
Oh!
For existences who had lived countless eons, witnessed the birth and death of concepts themselves, a single day was akin to the passage of a second.
Yet as the hours dwindled and the appointed time approached, even these ancient beings felt something that might have been anticipation.
The Living Existences had already begun their convergence toward the chosen location...a site that had sparked debate until the final moments.
Some had argued for the grandeur of the Origin Folds, others for the neutrality of the Spaces between Folds.

But ultimately, with irony that wasn’t lost on those who understood such things, they had chosen the Transcendent Temporal Folds...the very place where Dead Existences had first torn through the veil.
The specific region was deliberately mundane: an empty expanse far from the Temporal Heart where the Living Temporals concentrated their power.
Yet as agreement crystallized, the space began its transformation.
What had been void became venue, emptiness became amphitheater!
Tens of thousands had already gathered. Living Origins arrived in formations.

Living Temporals materialized at moments they deemed appropriate. Living Spirits drifted in like thoughts becoming solid. Living Quantums existed in multiple states of arrival simultaneously. Living Elementals burned, froze, flowed, and crystallized their way into being!

Living Dimensionals unfolded from spaces that shouldn’t have had room for them. Living Concepts appeared by first being understood, then being seen...and the remaining Living Existences had their own entrance.

The Living Paradoxes, notably, were barely represented...only Duke Elagabalus and a handful of others lounging with the particular casualness of those who knew arriving early was just another form of being late.
At the center of this gathering impossibility, Living Concepts had taken the lead in construction.
Their forms...if they could be called forms...moved through the space like architects of reality itself, building with materials and with ideas given substance.

The structure taking shape was glorious. It was a coliseum, but one that existed in more dimensions than three. Ten sections divided the space equally, each one attuned to the nature of its intended occupants.
Portals marked each section... statements of identity, each one declaring which breed of existence belonged within.

From the portal marked with the endless spiral of Living Origins, two figures emerged: Duke Whisker floating with his characteristic dignity, and beside him, Noah, who was shaking his head with visible exasperation.
“Why drag me away from Aeternitas Concordia when the Kleos Concordat hasn’t even begun?” Noah’s voice carried the irritation of someone interrupted from important work.

Duke Whisker’s whiskers twitched with amusement. “All Living Existences arrive before the appointed time to provide input to the Living Concepts. How would you prefer your space designed? Your own area with specifications of your choosing? Or would you simply prefer to sit with the Living Origins?”
The suggestion of being lumped in with others made Noah’s eyes shine with the light of someone who had just been offered an opportunity disguised as inconvenience.
“Okay,” he said, his irritation transforming into interest. “Let’s see how everything is.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4084: Fables and Pride! V
paragraphs: Duke Whisker began to float through the construction zone, his tiny form somehow maintaining dignity despite having to look up at almost everything.

Noah followed, his perception taking in details that others might miss...the way Living Concepts didn’t build but convinced space that it had always been built, the subtle hierarchies revealed in how different groups positioned themselves, the careful dance of power and pride playing out through architectural choices.

“That is Duke Vicialis there,” Duke Whisker indicated with a subtle gesture toward a gathering of Living Elementals. “He’s instructing his throne be forged from flames that burn backward through time. For some, mere fire isn’t sufficiently impressive anymore.”
Noah observed the Duke in question...a being whose form seemed to be combustion having an identity crisis.
“And there,” Duke Whisker continued, directing attention to another section, “Duke Voss of the Living Dimensionals...”
Duke Whisker calmly pointed out many things as Noah was able to observe the scale of the place where the Kleos Concordat would take place!
The construction continued around them, reality being reshaped by Living Concepts.
Noah watched as thrones were carved from crystallized time, platforms were woven from solid thought, and seating arrangements were negotiated.
“My dear Whisker, what an unexpected pleasure.”
HUUM!
The voice arrived with the weight of temporal authority wrapped in genuine warmth.
A figure materialized from temporal flux with the precision of someone who knew exactly when they wanted to arrive and had arranged causality to accommodate.
Golden hair that seemed to age and youth simultaneously, eyes that held the light of stars being born while watching them die!
This...was one of the nine Living Temporal Pillars, beings who supposedly maintained the Temporal Weave that kept the Folds from collapsing into sequential chaos.
Supposedly.

But when Moiraine had been revealing to Noah the structures of Living Existences and how Living Temporals and Living Spirits were the only ones who had unique hierarchies of ruling and not Kleos Councils...she had also mentioned that the idea that Nine Living Temporal Pillars being the ones to maintain the time of the Folds was utter bullshit.
And now, Noah actually got the chance to observe one such being.
“Living Temporal Pillar Chronos,” Duke Whisker acknowledged, his tone carrying respectful wariness.
“Such formality between old colleagues seems almost insulting to our shared history,” Chronos replied.

His attention shifted to Noah with the focus of someone who could see through time itself. “And who commands enough respect to receive Whisker’s personal attention? The temporal threads around you are... fascinating. They bend without breaking, accelerate without losing cohesion. Hey, I actually cannot even see a few seconds of what your future time could be when even for Dukes, I could at least see a few minutes. What’s that about? Who do you...represent?”
HUUM!
Noah met the ancient being’s gaze steadily. “I’m simply here to represent myself.”

“‘Simply’ and ‘myself’...two words that rarely belong in the same sentence at gatherings like these.” Chronos’s expression grew more intrigued, his presence making nearby beings unconsciously check whether they were experiencing the present or just remembering it.

“Most beings represent factions, ideologies, or abstract principles they barely understand. But you... you’re remarkably self-contained. Your timeline doesn’t leak into others’ futures. That requires either tremendous ignorance or tremendous control. Haha, I can’t figure you out!”
The assessment buzzed in the air as Chronos already knew which option applied.
His positivity wasn’t naive enthusiasm...it was the confidence of someone who had calculated all possible outcomes and known what could unfold!
And his eyes now gazes with interest towards Noah who...did not entertain it.
He turned towards Duke Whisker.

“I have an idea for how I want my space to look,” Noah said, smoothly redirecting while acknowledging the probe. He turned to Duke Whisker with specifications. “Simple. Understated. A few thrones crafted from materials that suggest growth rather than power. Positioned for observation without ostentation.”
Duke Whisker floated off to convey the specifications, leaving Noah with the Temporal Pillar whose presence made causality nervous.

“You know,” Chronos said conversationally, his smile fading slightly, “I’ve existed long enough to see patterns repeat until they become laws. Patters are the one thing I always see, and yet I cannot see yours. Why is that?”
A heavy question.
He studied Noah with eyes that saw through more than just space.
And as Noah faced the gaze of this powerful being...he remained calm and looked ahead as Duke Whisker returned!
“Your specifications have been conveyed,” Duke Whisker announced, returning with timing. “The Living Concepts were... intrigued. Your space will be carved out between Living Origins and Living Laws.”
Between two Living Existences. It would undoubtedly be unique!
The Living Temporal Pillar, Chronos, had none of his questions answered as he smiled at this as he rose up. He was a type of being that was supremely powerful, but unbothered!

“I look forward to seeing what someone who ‘simply represents himself’ contributes to the Concordat. In my experience, those who claim the least often have the most to offer. Or the most to hide. Either makes for excellent entertainment. I just came for introductions because the timeline of Duke Whisker here became chaotic and murky...you will have to be careful.”
With that perfectly calibrated mixture of compliment and warning, Chronos dispersed into temporal probability.
Duke Whisker and Noah floated calmly as around them, the 10 Living Existences continue weaving in and out calmly.
At such a point, Duke Whisker gazed towards Noah while sending a mental message only he could hear.
|All Living Existences are represented here, but...not the Living Order, right? You mentioned multiple Thrones for your section, do you plan to bring the Living Order here?|
Duke Whisker asked such a question as Noah smiled.

He sensed the terrifying waves of complexities surging in this area as a grand stage formed, with Royal Living Existences carrying gloriously powerful and prideful gazes moving in the distance to make sure their proper grandeur was displayed here.
Was such a thing still important? The hubris? The pride? The sheer fact that some thought themsleves higher than others as they moved to preserve their dignity through any means necessary?
Noah shook his head as his reply to Duke Whisker was a simple one.
“We will see.”
Truly, they would all see!

chapters.title: Chapter 4085: Losses and Gains! I
paragraphs: There are existences accustomed to winning...beings for whom victory is not achievement but expectation, for whom success is the baseline from which all other experiences are measured.
When such beings experience loss, the sensation transcends simple defeat.
It becomes existential crisis, a fundamental questioning of identity itself!
If you are defined by winning, what are you when you lose?
There were those existences, and then... there was Noah.
At this moment, he lay upon a vast white sea, his body carried by gentle waves that had once been cerulean but now shone with stellar radiance.
The light of Order had bombarded these waters so thoroughly, so completely, that they had forgotten their original color and adopted a new truth.
The waves moved with purpose that transcended physics, supporting him with the particular care of water that had been organized into knowing exactly how to hold someone.

He stared at a ceiling inside an isolated pocket dimension in the Abode of the Early Creature, and for perhaps the first time in his rapid ascension through impossibility, he had to admit something that sat strangely in his consciousness...
He had actually lost.
During his Dual Cultivation with THE Living Order, despite all his complexity, despite his multiple Seed Glyphs, despite being The Early Creature, Osmont..he had lost!

Not devastatingly, not humiliatingly, but definitively. Sigrid’s complexity and purity had exceeded his own, and he had learned firsthand what that distinction of [THE] truly meant when attached to a Living Existence.
Basically, he was manhandled by his girl!
The prompts floating before his vision offered consolation that transcended simple comfort.
|Extended Intimate Connection with THE Living Order (Awakening) Completed|
|Duration: Temporal Manipulation Extended - 72 Subjective Hours|
|Understanding of Order Fundamentally Enhanced|
|Existential Resonance Achieved|
|Purity Gained: +55,000,000,000|
|Complexity Gained: +25,000,000,000|
|Note: Differential gains reflect Order’s preference for purity over complexity|
|Additional Note: Being dominated by THE Living Order has its benefits|
The boons were indeed terrifying!
So even though he had lost control, had been the one guided rather than guiding, he couldn’t truly call it defeat.
The gains were unfathomable, his understanding of Order deepened beyond what solo cultivation could have achieved.
“Get up and stop making it seem like you were ravaged.”
Sigrid’s voice cut through his contemplation with the particular mix of affection and exasperation that had developed between them.

She stood nearby, tying her white hair into a ponytail with movements that were efficient yet graceful. The pure white robe she wore seemed to glow with its own light...or perhaps it was her light, Order itself radiating through simple fabric.
Noah rose from the stellar waters, droplets cascading down his bare torso like liquid starlight seeking return to the sea.

Each drop caught light that shouldn’t exist, creating momentary prisms before rejoining the vast white expanse. His lower body was adorned with pure white pants that seemed cut from the same conceptual fabric as restraint itself.
He looked at Sigrid with seriousness that transformed his usually tyrannical confidence into something heavier.

“All ten Living Existences that we’ve heard of have shown themselves to be larger than anything we could fathom.” His voice carried weight that made the white waters still their movement. “You’re awakening as the resurgence of THE Living Order, gaining power that reshapes reality just by existing. But there’s so much we don’t know. So much that remains hidden.”
He stepped closer, his gaze intense enough to make Order itself pay attention.
“Are you confident that as you keep awakening, as you attain more of THE Living Order’s power, that everything about you is remaining you?”
The question hung between them with importance.
“Because if anything feels off...if you sense something foreign trying to assert itself, tell me now. I can always take matters into my own hands.”
The implication was clear. He would rather stop her awakening, rather limit her power, than lose her to something wearing her face.

Sigrid moved toward him across the stellar white sea, her steps creating ripples that organized themselves into perfect concentric circles. She sat beside him, then shifted to lay her head on his lap, looking up at the ceiling with eyes that contained depths of contemplation.
Her arm reached upward, fingers grasping at something invisible...perhaps trying to capture certainty in a situation that offered none.
“I was just a girl who lost her entire family, my whole lineage, based on the orders of those above me.”
“I didn’t ask to become the resurgence of THE Living Order. I still don’t understand how it’s possible. But what happened, happened. Now I’m here.”
She paused, her hand still reaching toward something beyond the ceiling.

“I may not have my family anymore, but I’ve found something else. Someone else.” Her gaze shifted to meet his. “I was terrified you would be like the Living Origins...someone who only wanted to use me for what I represented. But then you brought me here. You showed me your Shore, your family, your mother who accepted me with a single word. Your people who treat me as myself rather than my title.”
Her expression softened with vulnerability that THE Living Order probably shouldn’t show.

“With all of this, my heart is at ease. Which is why even though I can feel something terrifying arising inside me...power that wants to organize everything it touches, I feel like I can handle it. Because you’re here.”
She placed her hand on her chest, closing her eyes as if listening to something within.

“I’m beginning to obtain pieces of memories from an extremely long time ago. The Earliest Folds. They’re hazy, like looking through water at stars, but they’re becoming clearer as I grow more complex, more pure. These memories... they’ll have answers. About what happened. About what’s coming.”
Her eyes opened, finding his with intensity that made the white waters around them ripple.
“Besides, you’ve bound me, haven’t you?” The question was rhetorical, acknowledging the connections between them that transcended everything.

“If I ever go crazy, if THE Living Order somehow overwrites who I am, you can simply put me under control. These bindings you have on me...emotional, physical, existential, they’re not chains. They’re anchors.”
Change in chap titles

When such beings experience loss, the sensation transcends simple defeat.
It becomes existential crisis, a fundamental questioning of identity itself!
If you are defined by winning, what are you when you lose?
There were those existences, and then... there was Noah.
At this moment, he lay upon a vast white sea, his body carried by gentle waves that had once been cerulean but now shone with stellar radiance.
The light of Order had bombarded these waters so thoroughly, so completely, that they had forgotten their original color and adopted a new truth.
The waves moved with purpose that transcended physics, supporting him with the particular care of water that had been organized into knowing exactly how to hold someone.

He stared at a ceiling inside an isolated pocket dimension in the Abode of the Early Creature, and for perhaps the first time in his rapid ascension through impossibility, he had to admit something that sat strangely in his consciousness...
He had actually lost.
During his Dual Cultivation with THE Living Order, despite all his complexity, despite his multiple Seed Glyphs, despite being The Early Creature, Osmont..he had lost!
Not devastatingly, not humiliatingly, but definitively.
Sigrid’s complexity and purity had exceeded his own, and he had learned firsthand what that distinction of [THE] truly meant when attached to a Living Existence.
Basically, he was manhandled by his girl!
The prompts floating before his vision offered consolation that transcended simple comfort.
|Extended Intimate Connection with THE Living Order (Awakening) Completed|
|Duration: Temporal Manipulation Extended - 72 Subjective Hours|
|Understanding of Order Fundamentally Enhanced|
|Existential Resonance Achieved|
|Purity Gained: +55,000,000,000|
|Complexity Gained: +25,000,000,000|
|Note: Differential gains reflect Order’s preference for purity over complexity|
|Additional Note: Being dominated by THE Living Order has its benefits|

chapters.title: Chapter 4086: Losses and Gains! II
paragraphs: She reached up to touch his face with fingers that carried the temperature of absolute zero and infinite heat simultaneously...Order containing all states at once.

“If it was just me alone, yes, I would be terrified. But with you in the picture, with these connections between us, I feel like everything can remain orderly and straight. That this power can truly be used to establish order once more across the Folds, rather than becoming another tool for those who already have too much.”
HUUM!

Noah looked into the eyes of this woman he had begun being around not too long ago...time was relative when you could manipulate it, but he was becoming fond of her more and more as moments accumulated into meaning.
Her trust was a weight he chose to carry, her faith in him a responsibility he wouldn’t shirk.
He nodded at her answer, acceptance and determination mingling in the gesture.
Then he sighed... from recognition that reality insisted on interrupting intimate moments with practical concerns.

“Okay. But for now, it seems like we have to wrap up our venture into the Primordial Early Excavation Depths.” He shifted slightly, his expression growing more serious. “The Ninth Level is proving to be a bit... difficult.”
The ninth level!
After the first level’s revelations, Noah, Moiraine, Sigrid, Ruination, and the Infiniverse had continued their descent through the Primordial Early Excavation Depths for hours that felt like days.
Each level had presented new challenges, new treasures, and new understanding of what the Earliest Folds had left behind.
The results of their delving were profound, each discovery amplified by Noah’s three Glyphs of the Principle of Perpetual Harvest!
|Ore of Early Resonance Obtained: 47 units|
|Enhanced by Perpetual Harvest: 470 units total|
|Uses: Shore construct enhancement (Abode, Aquarium, Totems)|
|Refinement possible: 1 ingot = 100M CQ/PQ when consumed|
|Note: Enough to upgrade entire Shore infrastructure|
|Crystallized Temporal Fragments Obtained: 234 units|
|Enhanced by Perpetual Harvest: 2,340 units total|
|Primary use: Instant century-growth for plants|
|Secondary use: Permanent soil enhancement when powdered|
|Note: Sufficient to accelerate Shore’s agricultural evolution|
|Essence Gems Obtained: 13 units|
|Enhanced by Perpetual Harvest: 130 units total|
|Direct consumption: +1 Billion CQ/PQ per gem|
|Alternative: Dissolve in Sacred Waters to summon Eminent/Kleos Marine Lifeforms|
|Note: Strategic reserve for rapid advancement or Shore population|
|Paradox Minerals Obtained: 156 units|
|Enhanced by Perpetual Harvest: 1,560 units total|
|Primary use: Forge tools functioning beyond normal limitations|
|Special property: Items work within Doorways to the Loom|
|Note: Sufficient for complete paradoxical armament set|
The loot obtained had been abundant!
The Essence Gems and Ores of Early Resonance particularly so as they represented billions in Complexity and Purity
But perhaps the most peculiar discovery had been an Early Creature Artifact on the fifth level.
|The Slipper of Existential Humiliation|
|Classification: Worn Early Creature Artifact (Left Foot Only)|
|Alignment: Living Quantum Authority (Somehow)|
|Condition: “Well-loved” (Translation: Beaten to hell)|
|Primary Ability: Conceptual Diminishment|
- When used to strike beings or authorities: Target becomes “small and meaningless”
- Effect scales with wielder’s contempt for target
- Note: Particularly effective against those with inflated self-importance
|Secondary Ability: Quantum Embarrassment|
- Target exists in superposition of dignity and humiliation
- Observers collapse wave function toward whichever is more brutal
- Warning: May cause existential crisis in beings
|Additional Note: Right slipper presumably still being worn somewhere|
Noah contemplated this absurd arsenal while stroking Sigrid’s hair, his consciousness split between the intimate moment in the Abode with many others and his main body standing in the Ninth Level.
The contrast between peace and danger, between victory and challenge, defined his existence now.

The previous eight levels had presented terrifying existential hazards....environments where paradox itself attacked, where concepts became hostile, where the mere act of observation could unmake the observer.
These hazards had slowed their progress more than any enemy could have.
Until now, they had encountered no other Remnant Lifeforms besides Kelgar. Only hostile environments and the endless need to break through crystallized reality to continue forward.
The Ninth Level changed that.
They stood now in an environment that defied simple description. Waves of Living Conceptual Authority saturated the space with pressure that made breathing an act of will.
The realm stretched vast and broken...grey-bronze earthen fragments and crystals floated everywhere, filling space with chaotic patterns.

Each piece, from pebble to boulder, carried lethal conceptual authority. A single impact from even the smallest fragment could injure an Honored Living Existence, each one containing concepts that shouldn’t be weaponized.
At the center of this maelstrom of hostile geology stood their second Remnant Lifeform.
But this one made them all become somber, because the power emanating from it was unmistakably that of a Duke.
Exceedingly so!
|Ninth Level Reached: The Conceptual Graveyard|
|Ambient Danger: Extreme|
|Remnant Lifeform Identified: Aurelius the Severed Echo|
|Classification: Isolated Clone of Fold Dweller Aurelius|
|Status: Cut from original, existing on residual authority|
|Memory State: None (Pure instinct and power)|
|Power Level: Duke (Exceeds standard parameters)|
Noah studied these prompts with stern focus. The pressure emanating from this being exceeded even Duke Gwendolyn’s.

“That creature is filled with entropy,” Sigrid said, her voice cold with recognition of danger. “If any of us step within its proximity, our lesser complexity and purity will be overcome. We’ll be led into irreversible, cyclical entropy...dissolution that feeds on itself until nothing remains.”
The Remnant, Aurelius the Severed Echo, stood with disturbing elegance.
Unlike Kelgar’s degraded state, this clone seemed well-preserved.
Radiantly blue hair flowed like liquid sapphire, eyes shimmered like blue galaxies containing their own gravitational pull.
His body was surrounded by chaotic energy of impossible blue...not just the color but the concept of blue weaponized, made hostile, given intent to unmake.
Ruination’s eyes blazed with interest at Sigrid’s warning. The prospect of facing entropy, of ending that ended endlessly, appealed to her nature as an Early Living Ruin.
“No,” Noah said, stepping forward with authority that made even Ruination pause. “We won’t be able to overcome this creature. Beyond having Duke-level power, its authority exceeds normal Dukes.”
He paused, and his eyes flashed with something devilish.
“But that doesn’t mean we cannot at least make an effort.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4087: Resistance! I
paragraphs: The word ’effort’ carried special weight now. It was the key to his most terrifying power...the Seed of the Principle of Perpetual Harvest that rewarded any attempt, any try, any exertion toward a goal.
"Support me," he commanded those with him, taking a single step forward.
They all felt it...the invisible line the clone had drawn. A boundary that said ’beyond this point, you cease.’ Not a threat but a statement of fact, like warning signs before a cliff.
Noah’s foot crossed the line.
The moment his toe breached that invisible boundary, Aurelius’s eyes that swirled like galaxies flickered toward him with the lazy interest of someone noticing an insect.

Noah’s leg began to vibrate...not with external force but with internal dissolution. From the very tip of his toes, disintegration began. Not violent but methodical, atoms forgetting they were supposed to be connected, molecules deciding existence was optional!
If he didn’t pull back, his leg would cease entirely within seconds.
But Noah’s complexity and purity blazed with defiance. Behind him, Sigrid’s body erupted with Order’s light, imposing structure on chaos. Moiraine channeled her authority!
Ruination paradoxically ended the ending attacking Noah. The Infiniverse asserted that Noah was part of her, and she did not permit dissolution!

For seconds that stretched like hours, Noah’s leg trembled on the edge of unbeing. The myriad authorities supporting him fought against entropy that wasn’t even trying, that was simply the natural state near Aurelius.

The clone smiled...an expression of recognition rather than amusement. Its gaze fixed on Yoshinami’s crown on Noah’s head, understanding that active hostility would provoke something beyond its isolated state.
So it didn’t attack. It simply existed, and its existence was hostile to lesser beings.
Their gazes met across impossible distance.

Noah’s eyes carried a singular message: Today, he nearly dissolved from one step forward. But he would return. And when he did, no part of him would face disintegration when he crossed that line again!
This was promise, threat, and prophecy combined.
Noah pulled his foot back, the relief of continued existence flooding through him.
|Tremendous Effort Recognized|
|Attempting impossible confrontation with Duke-level threat|
|Effort includes: Courage, calculation, and strategic withdrawal|
|The Principle of Perpetual Harvest rewards wisdom in recognizing limits|
|Complexity gained: +5,000,000,000|
|Purity gained: +5,000,000,000|
|Understanding gained: Nature of Conceptual Entropy|
|Future benefit: Resistance to entropic dissolution building|
An astounding boon due to effort!
Noah turned to face his party, his expression mixing satisfaction with anticipation of future victory.
But Noah, being who he was, didn’t immediately leave.
Instead, he turned back to the invisible line with the particular gleam in his eyes of someone who had discovered a loophole in existence’s programming.
"Let me try something."
Before anyone could object, he stepped forward again, his foot crossing the line.
Once more, disintegration began. Once more, his supporting party channeled their authorities to preserve him!
Once more, he pulled back.
And surely...
|Second Effort Recognized|
|Identical action to previous attempt|
|Principle acknowledges persistence|
|Complexity gained: +2,500,000,000|
|Purity gained: +2,500,000,000|
|Note: Rewards halved due to repetition|
Oh!
What a glorious thing Perpetual Harvest was!
"Interesting," Noah muttered, and stepped forward again.
|Third Effort Recognized|
|Pattern detected: Repetitive boundary testing|
|Diminishing returns applied|
|Complexity gained: +1,000,000,000|
|Purity gained: +1,000,000,000|
|Warning: Effort requires novelty for full reward|
Sigrid blinked behind him. "What are you doing?"
"Testing something," Noah replied, already positioning for another attempt.
|Fourth Effort Recognized|
|Seriously?|
|Complexity gained: +500,000,000|
|Purity gained: +500,000,000|
|The Principle of Perpetual Harvest is getting bored|
Moiraine’s eyes shone brightly!

Ruination watched with the particular interest of someone witnessing self-destructive behavior as performance art. The Infiniverse simply observed, cataloging this particular glory of her master’s personality.
Noah stepped forward a fifth time.
|Fifth "Effort" Acknowledged|
|Look, we need to talk|
|You’re literally just stepping forward and back|
|That’s not effort, that’s a weird dance|
|The Principle of Perpetual Harvest has standards|
|Complexity gained: +0|
|Purity gained: +0|
|Suggestion: Go find something else to do|
|Additional suggestion: Maybe something actually challenging?|
|Final note: The clone thinks you look ridiculous|
Noah’s eyes became sharp at these weavings of information - at these prompts!
They were becoming a bit wild.
But truly...
Indeed, Aurelius the Severed Echo was now watching with an expression that suggested even an isolated fragment of consciousness could experience amusement and pity.
Noah looked at the prompts with the particular expression of someone whose cheat had been patched.
"Fine," he said, turning away with as much dignity as someone could muster. "Now we can go."
As they began their ascent back through the levels, Sigrid moved beside him.

Behind them, the Ninth Level remained, Aurelius still standing in his maelstrom of conceptual hostility. The challenge remained, waiting for when they were actually ready rather than just repeatedly poking it to farm rewards.
The Primordial Early Excavation Depths had given them much, but they had also shown them how far they still had to go!

Duke-level threats that could dissolve them with presence alone. Mysteries buried in stone and memory. And the sobering reminder that effort without genuine risk or growth was just motion without meaning.
"Let’s go," Noah said again, this time with finality. "The Kleos Concordat awaits as there are last minute preparations..."
The entrance to the Primordial Early Excavation Depths released them back onto the golden sands with the gentle finality of a door closing on completed business.
|All defeated Remnant Lifeforms remain so, but Materials will regenerate and be available for mining after some time.|
A prompt flashed as Noah and his party emerged, each carrying the weight of their discoveries and the satisfaction of resources well-earned.
Noah’s gaze swept across the Early Veiled Shore, taking in what had become the starting point of something unfathomably grand!
The transformation from failed fragment to thriving ecosystem continued even in their absence, each element building upon the others in patterns that suggested design emerging from chaos!
The Aquarium in the distance drew particular attention. Dozens of Marine Lifeforms now swam through its expanded waters.

All of this was simply creating a snowball effect of life generating life, complexity building complexity. It was sustainability through abundance, the kind of system that would eventually make scarcity a forgotten concept!

|Pattern detected: Repetitive boundary testing|
|Diminishing returns applied|
|Complexity gained: +1,000,000,000|
|Purity gained: +1,000,000,000|
|Warning: Effort requires novelty for full reward|
Sigrid blinked behind him.
"What are you doing?"
"Testing something," Noah replied, already positioning for another attempt.
|Fourth Effort Recognized|
|Seriously?|
|Complexity gained: +500,000,000|
|Purity gained: +500,000,000|
|The Principle of Perpetual Harvest is getting bored|
Moiraine’s eyes shone brightly!
Ruination watched with the particular interest of someone witnessing self-destructive behavior as performance art.
The Infiniverse simply observed, cataloging this particular glory of her master’s personality.
Noah stepped forward a fifth time.
|Fifth "Effort" Acknowledged|
|Look, we need to talk|
|You’re literally just stepping forward and back|
|That’s not effort, that’s a weird dance|
|The Principle of Perpetual Harvest has standards|
|Complexity gained: +0|
|Purity gained: +0|
|Suggestion: Go find something else to do|
|Additional suggestion: Maybe something actually challenging?|
|Final note: The clone thinks you look ridiculous|
Noah’s eyes became sharp at these weavings of information - at these prompts!
They were becoming a bit wild.
But truly...
Indeed, Aurelius the Severed Echo was now watching with an expression that suggested even an isolated fragment of consciousness could experience amusement and pity.
Noah looked at the prompts with the particular expression of someone whose cheat had been patched.
"Fine," he said, turning away with as much dignity as someone could muster.
"Now we can go."
As they began their ascent back through the levels, Sigrid moved beside him.
Behind them, the Ninth Level remained, Aurelius still standing in his maelstrom of conceptual hostility.
The challenge remained, waiting for when they were actually ready rather than just repeatedly poking it to farm rewards.
The Primordial Early Excavation Depths had given them much, but they had also shown them how far they still had to go!
Duke-level threats that could dissolve them with presence alone.
Mysteries buried in stone and memory.
And the sobering reminder that effort without genuine risk or growth was just motion without meaning.
"Let’s go," Noah said again, this time with finality.
"The Kleos Concordat awaits as there are last minute preparations..."
The entrance to the Primordial Early Excavation Depths released them back onto the golden sands with the gentle finality of a door closing on completed business.
|All defeated Remnant Lifeforms remain so, but Materials will regenerate and be available for mining after some time.|
A prompt flashed as Noah and his party emerged, each carrying the weight of their discoveries and the satisfaction of resources well-earned.
Noah’s gaze swept across the Early Veiled Shore, taking in what had become the starting point of something unfathomably grand!
The transformation from failed fragment to thriving ecosystem continued even in their absence, each element building upon the others in patterns that suggested design emerging from chaos!
The Aquarium in the distance drew particular attention.
Dozens of Marine Lifeforms now swam through its expanded waters.
All of this was simply creating a snowball effect of life generating life, complexity building complexity.
It was sustainability through abundance, the kind of system that would eventually make scarcity a forgotten concept!

chapters.title: Chapter 4088: Resistance! II
paragraphs: The golden sands beneath his feet hummed with accumulated power.

The Sacred Totems stood at their posts, their storage spaces now rich with materials from the plots and the Depths. The trees bore fruits that pulsed with readiness for harvest, with the Tenders already harvesting!
Everything was acceleration, everything was growth, everything was potential becoming actual.
Yet even surrounded by this prosperity, Noah knew that time was narrowing toward a point of convergence. The Kleos Concordat loomed, and with it, whatever the Living Paradoxes had planned.

He breathed out, the exhalation carrying decision. With a wave of his hand, thirteen Essence Gems materialized from his storage, their crystallized complexity catching light that existed in spectrums beyond normal perception.

"Moiraine," he said, the gems floating toward her with purpose. "Use these. 130 Essence Gems will grant you more than 130 billion in Complexity and Purity. Use that advancement to forge the Kleos Glyphs of Paradoxical Genesis, then sacrifice them for the Shards..."
The weight of the instruction settled on her with understanding.
More Principles meant more options, more understanding of how existence’s fundamental forces operated.

"The more we know about Principles, the more we can grasp them, the better positioned we’ll be," Noah continued. "Every Seed we understand is another rule we might learn to write rather than just follow."
Moiraine nodded, accepting the radiant gems with hands that understood their value. She moved away to begin the process, each step carrying purpose that would transform potential into achievement.
"Be ready," Noah said to Ruination, the Infiniverse, and Sigrid.
The simple words carried layers...be ready for the Concordat, for conflict, for transformation, for whatever impossibility would next present itself as Tuesday.
He walked toward where the golden sands met the Sacred Waters, each step deliberate, measured, ceremonial. The warm waters accepted his presence as he sat, lapping at his legs and lower body.
He breathed in deeply, finding in this moment something precious...peace.

There were countless things going wrong at this very moment across existence. Threads of chaos wove through every Fold. Death and desolation played out their ancient dance in places he couldn’t see but knew existed.
Yet in all of this turbulence, one had to find time and place for peace. Not escape from responsibility, but recognition that everyone needed moments of stillness.
In this peace, Noah spoke with the commanding certainty of someone making declaration that Existnces would have to acknowledge.

"Like the Living Existences who transcend through distinction, like the Foldless Ones who forge resistances based on what they choose to embody...I shall enact my own True Absolute Existential Resistance on this day."
HUUM!
The words rang across the Shore with weight that made the Sacred Waters still their motion.
His own resistance.

Not borrowed, not granted, but forged from his own nature and understanding. He had been waiting since he began crafting his Early Creature’s heart, knowing this capability existed but understanding it required the right foundation.
"The resistance of Perpetual Harvest," he proclaimed, his voice carrying to every corner of his domain, "based on a true and genuine Principle, shall be forged within my existence!"
The moment the declaration completed, his heart responded.
THUMP.
The beat echoed across the Shore with force that transcended sound. This was an engine of transformation announcing its activation!
THUMP.
Again, louder, the sound carrying through dimensions that normally didn’t conduct sound. His heart had become both forge and hammer, tool and creation simultaneously.
THUMP.
Golden-green light began gathering around him, accumulating like harvest season compressed into moments.
The three Glyphs of the Seed of the Principle of Perpetual Harvest blazed on his body...forehead and both palms, their light providing not just power but authority.
They gave legitimacy to what he was attempting, permission from the Principle itself to forge this unprecedented resistance!
THUMP.
|Heartbeat of Perpetual Harvest Detected|
|Each beat resonating across Early Veiled Shore|
|Unintended benefit: Acoustic harvest occurring|
|All entities hearing heartbeat gain: +1,000,000 CQ/PQ per beat|
THUMP.
The Tenders paused in their endless labor, their forms straightening as complexity flowed into them with each thunderous heartbeat.
Emperor Penguin stood frozen mid-waddle, his form absorbing advancement with each pulse. Even the Marine Lifeforms in the Aquarium swam closer to the shore, drawn by the rhythm of growth itself!
THUMP.

The process was pain transformed into purpose. In the first chamber of his heart, runic words began carving themselves into his very being. In it, each golden-green letter a declaration that this resistance was not addition but fundamental integration.
PERPETUAL.
The word carved itself with agony that transcended sensation. This was conceptual pain, the hurt of forcing Existence to accept new rules about how it could interact with him.
HARVEST.

The second word followed, each letter a lesson in why most beings didn’t attempt to forge their own resistances. The pain suggested his heart might tear, might fail, might simply refuse to continue containing what he was forcing it to become.
THUMP. THUMP. THUMP.
The beats came faster now, a drumroll of transformation that made the entire Shore vibrate with sympathetic frequency.
Titano, massive and ancient, could only watch with wide eyes as his Brother underwent something that shouldn’t be possible at his level of development.
The golden-green light around Noah intensified, becoming less illumination and more statement.
When his eyes opened, beams of terrifying golden-green light shot forth as announcement...something fundamental had changed!
BOOM!
|True Absolute Existential Resistance Successfully Forged|
|Type: Perpetual Harvest (1% Principle Authority)|
|Resistance Effects:|
|Effort Multiplication Defense: Any attempt to harm requires exponential effort|
|Attackers must "pay" in effort to overcome resistance|
|Weak attacks simply fail - insufficient effort available|
|Strong attacks require conscious decision to expend massive effort|
|Some beings may stop mid-attack upon realizing effort cost|
|Psychological Deterrent: Sophisticated beings will question why attacking you requires such effort|
|May choose not to attack rather than pay incomprehensible effort cost|
|Creates hesitation in even superior opponents|
|Practical Application:|
|- Being punched now requires attacker to expend effort of punching 100 times
|- Conceptual attacks must overcome conceptual effort barriers
|- Even observation with hostile intent requires effort payment
|- Resistance scales with attacker’s power (percentage based, not flat)|
Noah stared at the prompts, feeling the change settle into his being like armor made of consequence itself.
This wasn’t immunity...beings could still harm him. But now they would have to mean it, have to want it enough to pay prices that might make them reconsider.

Golden-green light covered everything, transforming the Shore temporarily into a monochrome masterpiece of harvest coloration. In the distance, beings watched in shock as their Master completed something that shouldn’t have been possible.
"Brother...strong!" Titano said simply, but his tone carried awe that transcended his simple vocabulary!

chapters.title: Chapter 4089: Resistance! III
paragraphs: The waters around Noah had turned golden-green from proximity to his transformation, and as he stood, they retained that color...marked by contact with something that had transcended normal limitations!
He had forged a resistance that said...attacking him was no longer casual action but investment, and investments required considerable effort!
After successfully forging the Resistance of Perpetual Harvest, Noah felt his entire existence enriched with life force that transcended simple vitality.

The connection to the Principle had deepened beyond what he had deepened, becoming increasingly integrated with its fundamental nature. Every aspect of his being amplified, his complexity and purity rising with a steady certainty.
Then, deep within his existence, something else stirred. A core part of his being that had remained mostly dormant buzzed with sudden activity, and a prompt materialized before him.
|Absolute Fictional Transcendence resonates with your ascension|
|Threads of existence-spanning fables entangle with your being due to their importance and gravity|
|Most connections remain obscured due to overwhelming complexity|
|Limited observation currently possible|
|Proceed with partial revelation of a heavily entangled?|
Noah gazed at the prompt with eyes that had grown accustomed to impossibility.
A fable entangled with him was occurring out there as even in a limited fashion, part of him in his elevated state thought he should see it!
The tyrannical certainty in his voice carried across the Shore as he commanded.
"Proceed."

In the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds, at the center of an unknowable number of paradoxical rivers that flowed in directions that didn’t exist, Schrodinger floated above the corpses of Inevitabilities with the particular grace of someone who had just accomplished something that shouldn’t have been possible.
Obsidian light surrounded his figure... the absence of light given its own luminosity.
The complexity radiating from him had become so profound, so deafeningly present, that Diviticus scrambled backward with a mixture of awe and primal fear.
Even as a Duke, she could feel her existence questioning whether it should continue existing so close to whatever Schrodinger was becoming.
As the obsidian light intensified, wrapping around him like a cocoon of dark possibility, Schrodinger began to speak.
His voice carried the weight of someone who had seen the patterns behind patterns, the rules behind rules.

"Chaos and disorder," he began, his tone philosophical yet carrying undertones that made reality lean in to listen. "Most beings fear them, flee from them, build entire civilizations as bulwarks against their encroachment. But they misunderstand something fundamental..."
The obsidian light pulsed with each word, as if his speech was conducting some terrible orchestra.

"Chaos isn’t the enemy of existence...it’s existence’s natural state. From the moment THE Creature first distinguished between ’is’ and ’isn’t,’ entropy began its work. Every action increases disorder. Every thought fragments unity into multiplicity. Every choice splits one path into many."
He raised his hand, and the dead Inevitabilities below seemed to resonate with his words, their corpses reminders of hunger that could never be satisfied.

"Consider this truth...it takes constant effort to maintain order. A cleaned room naturally becomes messy. A structured society naturally develops complications. Even THE Living Existences, with all their power, must constantly work to maintain their hierarchies, their Folds, their very identities against the tide of dissolution."
His smile contained layers of meaning that contradicted each other.

"But chaos? Chaos requires no effort. It simply is. It’s the default state toward which everything tends. Existence doesn’t need to work to become more chaotic...that happens automatically. It’s order that’s unnatural, temporary, fragile, and takes a great deal of effort."
The obsidian light around him grew denser, more real than the reality it displaced.

"Yet the profound paradox that most never grasp is that chaos, properly understood and properly wielded, is actually the most efficient tool for creating true order. Not the false order of rigid structure that must be constantly maintained, but the deep order that emerges from chaos itself...patterns that arise not despite disorder but because of it."
He gestured at the swirling rivers around them, each one a paradox made liquid.

"Look at these rivers. They flow in impossible directions, follow no laws, acknowledge no boundaries. Pure chaos. Yet they’ve been flowing in these same chaotic patterns for eons. The chaos has become its own form of reliability. The disorder has organized itself into something dependable."
His voice grew more intense, more certain.

"This is what others fail to understand. You don’t fight chaos...you surf it. You don’t resist entropy, you accelerate it toward your desired outcome. You don’t build walls against disorder...you become disorder’s favorite expression."

The obsidian light suddenly erupted upward in a beam that pierced through dimensional boundaries. Then, like a flower blooming in reverse and forward simultaneously, countless beams of obsidian light cascaded outward from his form.
They bypassed the paradoxical rivers as if they were merely suggestions, spreading across the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds with the inexorable advance of night.
Just like when THE Living Order had begun awakening, but inverse...where she had spread white light of structure, he spread obsidian acknowledgment of chaos.
Schrodinger smiled calmly, though the expression contained exhaustion. He sighed, and when he spoke again, his words carried the weight of destiny recognized!
"It seems I have begun walking the path to potentially become... THE Living Chaos."
BOOM!
"Potentially...everything is still but a possibility. But this...is something!"
The admission hung in the air.

"I did not expect events to play out like this," he continued, his tone mixing wonder with irony. "I have THE Living Order to thank for this opportunity. Thank her even more for leaving behind and discarding part of her Everything that allowed her to awaken...tossing it into an Inevitability as if it were garbage."
He chuckled, the sound containing genuine amusement.

"Before that part of her could be fully digested by the Inevitability, it became mine. What The Order discarded to become more ordered...I’ve claimed it, inverted it, made it the seed of its opposite. Now this is the path I walk... what a wonder. What a glory of how things can turn out. Hmm..."

The aura leaking from Schrodinger intensified, becoming not just grander but more fundamentally wrong. Not evil, but wrong in the way that suggested right and wrong were about to become obsolete categories.
Diviticus scrambled back even further, her Duke-level existence actually whimpering at proximity to transformation this profound.
"THE Living Order rises again," Schrodinger mused, his beggar’s appearance now the ultimate paradox-infinite power in humble form.
"And in response, perhaps THE Living Chaos will emerge. Not to oppose her, but to complete the equation. Order and Chaos, not as enemies but as dance partners in existence’s oldest waltz..."

The obsidian light continued spreading, touching everything in the Transcendent Paradoxical Folds with the gentle insistence of entropy itself. Where it passed, rigid structures became slightly more fluid.
Fixed laws developed slight variations.
Certainty admitted, if only to itself, that maybe it wasn’t so certain after all.

"Chaos," Schrodinger said with finality, "isn’t the absence of order. It’s the presence of all possible orders, happening simultaneously, waiting for observation to collapse them into pattern. Oh, what a wonder existence is!"
BOOM!
