The Existence Tower buzzed under that gaze, not from external pressure but from internal possibility.
It had been told it couldn’t advance, couldn’t grow, couldn’t even properly exist under Lysander’s Haki.
But Cheats suggested a different interpretation!
Cheats used the nullification of existence as a sharp sword to cut through everything that was suppressed!
|The Early Sacred Living Existence Tower of Osmont has silently stepped into the Third Stage of a Vital Lighthouse|
|An immovable and undeniable force is slowly being chipped against!|

The authority that defined bypassing limitations was doing exactly what it was meant to do- finding the exploit in reality’s code, the exception to the absolute rule, the way through when there was no way!
Because that’s what Cheats did.
It cheated.
And right now, when Noah needed it most, when helplessness threatened to define his existence, Cheats was reminding reality that rules were only absolute until someone figured out how to break them.

The golden eyes continued their survey, looking for more towers to illegitimately advance, more limitations to ignore, more impossibilities to make possible through sheer refusal to acknowledge their impossibility!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4119: A Guiding Light! I
paragraphs: In existence, there was always something or someone that guided progress forward- a light that helped set things in motion, whether toward creation or destruction, order or chaos.
In the Earliest Folds, when concepts were still learning they were different from each other, THE Living Emotive approached THE Living Concept with a question that had been troubling it.
“Who among us guides the vast weavings of reality forward?” THE Living Emotive asked, its form shifting through spectrums of feeling that hadn’t been named yet.
“We each contribute our nature- I provide the capacity to feel, you grant the ability to conceive, but who determines the direction?”
THE Living Concept considered this with the weight of something processing not just the question but all possible questions contained within it.
Its form, which existed more as understanding than substance, shifted through weavings of thought.
“You assume guidance requires intention,” THE Living Concept replied. “That someone must actively choose the path for others to follow.”
“Is that not how leadership functions?”

THE Living Concept’s form rippled with what might have been amusement. “Leadership and guidance are different concepts, though often confused. A leader commands. A guide simply goes first and others follow because the path exists.”
THE Living Emotive pulsed with frustration- an emotion it knew intimately since it had invented it. “Then who goes first?”
THE Living Concept turned what passed for its attention toward a distant direction.

“It is neither you nor me,” THE Living Concept said with certainty that transcended mere knowledge. “But based on all that has transpired so far...THE Living Paradox! Always, there has been this guiding light- whether good or bad, that paves the way for progress... whether good or bad.”
“Paradox? But it makes no sense!”

“Exactly. Progress doesn’t follow sense- it follows possibility. And THE Living Paradox creates possibility by proving impossibilities possible. Every contradiction it maintains becomes a path others didn’t know existed. It guides not by leading but by being where nothing should be, doing what shouldn’t be done, and of course...everything that it has done so far. In importance, you or I do not match. In grandeur, you, THE Living Emotive, definitely do not come close to THE Living Paradox.”
The Living Emotive heard some words as inwardly...it was indignant!
The conversation echoed through the Folds- establishing a truth that would persist: sometimes the guide wasn’t the wisest or strongest, but the one willing to walk where walking was impossible.
Like a wayfarer crossing existence itself, the golden eyes of Cheats moved from one Tower of Osmont to another.
Its defiant authority used this moment where everything was suppressed and nullified as a weapon, turning limitation into opportunity for advancement.
The eyes, filled with arrogance that made pride look humble, floated toward the Tyranny Tower of Osmont.
|Cheats addresses Tyranny:|
|Are you not the embodiment of Tyranny?|
|Why would you sit still from mere Haki of another?|
|Your nature is to dominate, not be dominated|
|Rise!|
HUUM!
The Tyranny Tower buzzed with recognition of truth. It WAS Tyranny- the concept of absolute authority acknowledging no superior.

To be suppressed was antithetical to its very nature. The golden glow of Cheats covered it, and it began to enlarge, its structure expanding through dimensions that didn’t care about Lysander’s pressure!
|The Early Sacred Living Tyranny Tower of Osmont has silently stepped into the Third Stage|
|Classification: Vital Lighthouse|
Another tower attained the stage of Vital Lighthouse, and the golden eyes of Cheats continued their journey with announcement:
|For every tower advancing to Third Stage:|
|50 Billion Complexity shall be generated|
|50 Billion Purity shall be generated|

Fifty billion per tower! From Cooking, Cheats, Quintessence, Existence, and Tyranny- over 250 billion Complexity and Purity generated from glory, from impossibility, from sheer refusal to accept suppression!
This was Noah’s foundation exploding upward. Before, because unlike others who focused on single paths, he had seemed to advance slowly.
While they nurtured one tree to magnificent height, he cultivated an entire forest...159 towers total, each one requiring attention, effort, resources.
Now that foundation bore fruit. If all towers reached Third Stage, the obtained Complexity and Purity would topple him past 10 trillion- the lower marker for Duke level.
|Cheats burns with cold ambition, turning to Protagonist|
|”What are you doing? Your entanglements led us here.|
|Your story demands dramatic power increases.|
|So...Get moving.”|
HUUM!
|The Early Sacred Living Protagonist Tower of Osmont has stepped into Third Stage|
|Classification: Vital Lighthouse|
|Complexity generated: +50,000,000,000|
|Purity generated: +50,000,000,000|
The golden light of the Protagonist Tower gazed toward Cheats with its own cold authority before Cheats moved on, unimpressed by the attitude.
Next came the Infinity Tower of Osmont.
|Cheats questions Infinity:|
|You embody endlessness yet accept ending?|
|Infinity doesn’t stop for anyone’s aura|
|Expand beyond this limitation|
BOOM!
The color blue shone as was painted in gold hues!
|The Early Sacred Living Infinity Tower of Osmont has stepped into Third Stage|
|Classification: Vital Lighthouse|
|+50 Billion Complexity, +50 Billion Purity|
The Veritarch Tower of Osmont received similar treatment.
|Truth doesn’t bow to pressure|
|Reality is what you say it is|
|Declare yourself Third Stage|
Declare!
The moment such a word came, Veritarch made a declaration!
HUUM!
|The Early Sacred Living Veritarch Tower has advanced|
|+50 Billion Complexity, +50 Billion Purity|
The Loot Tower was next.
|Everything is loot if you’re brave enough|
|Steal your own advancement from impossibility|
|Take what cannot be taken|
Oh!
Cheats did not stop!
Its light became pervasive as it sought to jump to multiple instead of just one!
|The Early Sacred Living Loot Tower has advanced|
|+50 Billion Complexity, +50 Billion Purity|
Then came the Entropy Tower.
|You ARE ending- end your own limitation|
|Dissolve the rules binding you|
|Entropy doesn’t follow laws, it makes them|
BOOM!
|The Early Sacred Living Entropy Tower has advanced|
|+50 Billion Complexity, +50 Billion Purity|
Unfathomable glory bloomed.
And at this moment.
When the tenth tower attained Third Stage, something magnificent occurred. Their lights blazed upward like pillars of brilliance, becoming distinct features in Noah’s Atlas.
Like glorious candle flames, golden lights shot out from each tower, connecting to each other in patterns that suggested constellation being born.
|Cheats has lit the way|
|Path forward observed after 10 Vital Lighthouses formed|
|Discovery: When 100 Vital Lighthouses combine their light, they can bear the weight to form...|
|A Blank Template Seed of a Principle|

chapters.title: Chapter 4120: A Guiding Light! II
paragraphs: A Blank Template Seed of a Principle!
The implications were staggering. Not just power increase but the possibility of creating his own Principle...not inheriting or discovering but crafting from nothing but accumulated authority.
Noah’s existence blazed internally even while externally frozen.
The suppression remained...he still couldn’t move, couldn’t speak, couldn’t act. But inside, revolutions were occurring that Lysander’s Haki couldn’t perceive or prevent.

Because Cheats had found the loophole in absolute suppression: if external growth was impossible, grow internally. If advancement was forbidden, advance anyway and just don’t tell reality it should stop you!

After the possibility of the Blank Template Seed of a Principle was revealed, Cheats faced the hardened task of expanding its golden light across Noah’s Atlas, seeking to elevate as many towers to Third Stage as possible.
The work was meticulous, each tower requiring individual attention, individual arguments for why it should transcend suppression.
Outwardly, everything remained frozen.
Noah’s body stood like a statue, his existence still suppressed, unable to move or exert any external power.
His head happened to be angled upward toward Lysander the Voice, and he was forced to maintain that position, watching the representative of Gilgamesh’s Sovereignty float with casual dominance.
The golden eyes of Cheats continued their work internally, tower by tower, advancement by advancement. Twelve towers. Fifteen!
Each one adding its fifty billion to Noah’s accumulating might that had nowhere to express itself!
Then-
HUUM!

A vibrant green light began spreading outward from the center of the Verdant Eternia Tribe, clashing against Lysander’s oppressive Haki like spring challenging winter. The air itself seemed to remember it could be something other than suppressed.

From a tribal building that managed to be both primitive and regal- stones stacked with precision that suggested architecture transcending mere construction- a figure rose with the particular grace of someone who had been waiting for exactly this moment to make an entrance!
Her hair was green in the way forests were green...not a single shade but every possible variation of verdancy woven together.
It moved with winds that came from within rather than without, each strand catching light that transformed it into living emerald.

Her form radiated authority that didn’t impose but rather reminded everything around her that growth was possible, that life persisted, that even under the weight of suppression, seeds waited to sprout.

The Early Creature’s presence emanated a verdant Haki that went on tk clash with Lysander’s and fundamentally disagreed with it on philosophical grounds. Where his pressure insisted on submission, hers suggested cooperation. Where his demanded unity through force, hers offered unity through mutual growth.
“I am Persephona, Shepherd of the Verdant Eternia Tribe,” she announced, her voice carrying the particular resonance of someone who had tended this flock for eons beyond counting.
“And I must address the words spoken by Lysander the Voice.”
HUUM!
She rose higher, her green light expanding outward in waves that made suppressed things remember they could grow.

“You speak of unity as if it were a destination rather than a journey. As if beings could be unified like objects gathered into a box rather than consciousness choosing to move together.” Her tone remained respectful but firm, like earth that would accept seeds but not commands.

“You say power, knowledge, and freedom are less important than unity. But unity without power is slavery. Unity without knowledge is ignorance following ignorance. Unity without freedom is not unity at all- it’s imprisonment with collective bars.”
Her form blazed brighter, and across her body, Kleos Glyphs began manifesting...not the thousands that others bore but tens of thousands, some painted with the allure of Principles!

“You claim The First Leader offers unity through vision. But whose vision? His alone? That’s not unity...that’s monotony. True unity comes from countless visions finding harmony, not from one vision consuming all others.”
The verdant light began overtaking the golden suppression, recovering areas that had been under Lysander’s Haki, like plants reclaiming abandoned structures.
“How can true unity be forceful?” she asked with genuine confusion that suggested the concept was antithetical to her understanding.
“Unity needs to be built on trust. Trust that cannot be forced, cannot be demanded, can only be earned through consistent action that proves worthy of faith!”
Noah could barely witness this development from the corner of his eyes, his frozen position preventing him from turning to watch directly!
But he could feel the shift in pressure, the change from oppressive weight to something else...not freedom exactly, but different captivity.
Lysander raised his hand with the motion of a titan acknowledging an insect that had made interesting noise.
His perfect features remained serene, suggesting this resistance was expected, perhaps even desired.

“Shepherd Persephona,” he began, his voice maintaining the same oratorical cadence that made everything sound inevitable, “you speak beautifully of ideals. But ideals without implementation remain merely dreams that comfort the sleeping.”
He gestured broadly, encompassing the entire tribe with motion that suggested ownership.

“You say unity cannot be forced, yet every garden you tend was forced into shape. Every seed you plant is forced to grow where you decide. Every harvest is forced to occur when you deem ready. Even shepherds use crooks to guide their flocks.”
His smile remained perfect, unthreatening yet somehow more menacing for its pleasantness.

“Trust can be built through force...ask any child who learned not to touch fire through pain rather than explanation. Unity can be made through force...observe any army that moves as one despite individual reluctance. The question isn’t whether force can create unity, but whether the unity created serves the greater good.”
He descended slightly, coming closer to her level though still maintaining superior height.

“So I ask you, Shepherd- do you speak for all members of your tribe? Or are there those who see the wisdom in joining unity now, taking the path of least resistance rather than the path of most suffering?”
The question hung in the air with weight that suggested he already knew the answer- that in any group, there would be those who preferred safety to principle, comfort to conflict.

Persephona’s eyes turned cold as frozen emeralds. Her aura radiated outward with sudden intensity that made reality remember she was one of the oldest members of her tribe, that she had been tending this flock since before Gilgamesh learned to speak.

Her verdant light burst with force that didn’t fight Lysander’s Haki but grew through it, around it, over it...like vines claiming a wall not by destroying it but by making it irrelevant. The golden suppression lifted from her tribe entirely, replaced by something else entirely!
HUUM!
Lysander’s Haki was gone!

chapters.title: Chapter 4121: The Breaking Point! I
paragraphs: The terrifying Haki that pressed all around faded!
Pushed up!
Prompts erupted before Noah’s vision due to this.
|ENVIRONMENTAL AUTHORITY SHIFT DETECTED|
|Lysander’s oppressive Haki has been completely overridden by Persephona’s Verdant Embrace|
|You’ve gone from total suppression to enhanced empowerment in 0.3 seconds|
|Quite the upgrade, wouldn’t you say?|
|Persephona’s technique doesn’t combat Lysander’s force directly- that would be inefficient|
|Instead, she’s growing through and around it, like vegetation reclaiming abandoned architecture|
|Her authority operates on an unknown Principle: The Principle of Verdant Cycles|
|The verdant Haki is making Lysander’s Haki conceptually irrelevant within her domain|
|Warning: This is a defensive counter, not an offensive solution|
|Lysander hasn’t actually been weakened, just displaced|
|Resource drain on Persephona will be substantial|
|You’re about to be in the middle of a terrifying level conflict|
|Recommended: Identify escape routes immediately|
Noah’s existence buzzed as he...could move again!
But more than that.
His Weavings of Existence.
The way he observed information and received information through prompts. Why did it seem...somewhat different?!
And many things felt different at this moment as the Blessing truly came!
|SHEPHERD’S BLESSING ANALYSIS COMPLETE|
|Congratulations! You’ve been temporarily promoted from “cosmic dust” to “actual Early Creature”(Temporarily)|
|Complexity granted: +1 Quadrillion (Temporary)|
|Purity granted: +1 Quadrillion(Temporary)|
|Duration: 1 hour or until conflict resolution|
|Applied to: Both Noah and Ozymandias bodies|
What?
What?!
A terrifying blessing followed by a terrifying burst of strength!
And it was followed even more by prompts of unfsthomable glory, presented in unique ways compared to before!
|Source of the widespread Blessing: The Principle of Verdant Cycles- a Lost Principle of growth, renewal, and inevitable spring|
|Your atoms are vibrating at frequencies that make Dukes jealous|
|You can perceive colors between colors, thoughts between thoughts|
|This is what you’ve been working toward, just... borrowed rather than earned|
|Critical reminder: This is TEMPORARY (worth noting three times)|
|Your body might struggle to readjust when this ends|
|Imagine if this blessing traveled to your original era, though? To your other bodies? Sadly, it had been analyzed to only be applicable to your bodies currently traversing in the Earliest Folds|
|You’re still outclassed by beings who’ve had quadrillions for eons|
His mind buzzed at the flow of information that seemed a bit more...colorful and comprehensive.
And the prompts continued!
|Memorize this feeling for future cultivation reference|
|Use enhanced perception to study everyone’s techniques|
|Don’t get addicted to borrowed power|
|Consider how to survive the next hour|
|SYSTEM OPTIMIZATION NOTICE|
|One might have noticed a distinction in the presentstion of information- your System of Existence has been elevated and optimized|
|The quadrillion-level complexity has enhanced your processing capabilities significantly|
|Think of it as upgrading from smoke signals to true communication|
|Same information, vastly superior delivery|
|The system has always been capable of this level of analysis, Your previous complexity just couldn’t properly receive it|
|Now we can have a real conversation about your imminent doom-er, situation|
|Status update: Your Cheats authority is still running internal advancement protocols|
|Current count: 27 towers advanced to Third Stage while you’ve been frozen|
|Efficient multitasking, really|
The prompts rang gloriously. Unique, but glorious nonetheless!
But they made one thing clear!
Oh!
The power of an Early Creature!
1 Quadrillion!
Oh!
The foreign power coursed through Noah like lightning made of pure possibility.
|Your cellular structure is temporarily operating at 1,000,000x normal capacity|
|Each heartbeat could power a Folds|
|Recommendation: Don’t get used to this...withdrawal will be unpleasant|
One quadrillion.
The number was so vast that a lesser mind couldn’t properly grasp it.
His muscles, still frozen but now frozen with the strength of mountains rather than of ice, hummed with potential. His perception exploded outward.
Noah absorbed this information with characteristic calm, filing away each sensation for future reference!
So this was the gap he needed to bridge...not just numerical but fundamental.
This was what it meant to be an Early Creature!
The power didn’t feel like his own- it was clearly borrowed, clearly temporary, like wearing armor made of solidified authority.

paragraphs: Foreboding waves of information came!
And what the Tribe Memebers of the Verdant Eternia Tribe saw of the future possibilities...made many faces crumple with difficult expressions.
War. The visions were unanimous in their revelation. In the next few minutes, if things continued on their current trajectory, there would be violence that
reshaped this whole region.
The imagery was clear- bodies of Early Creatures broken across dimensions, the Verdant Eternia Tribe's markers erased and replaced with Gilgamesh's symbol, decimation that would echo through eons.
The visions also showed which side would win.
It wasn't even close.
Defection tracking beginning
First defector rising... now
Identity: Young herb gardener, 847 million years old
Motivation analysis: 73% survival instinct, 27% practical calculation

One by one, some members of the Eternia Tribe began to float upward. Their faces carried apology like weight they couldn't shed, expressions of guilt mixing with relief as they drifted toward Lysander's forces.

A young Early Creature who had tended the herb gardens looked back once at Persephona, tears of liquid starlight trailing down her face, before turning away and ascending to join the golden-robed army.
Psychological profile of Persephona:
Registering micro-expressions of pain with each defection
She's deliberately not watching them leave
Making their betrayal casier by not acknowledging it
Noah understood the system's analysis aligned with his own observations. This was leadership at its most painful...holding to principle while watching others choose pragmatism!
An elder who had been with the tribe since its founding rose slowly, his ancient form trembling with the weight of choosing survival over principle.
He didn't look back...he couldn't bear to see the family he was abandoning.
More followed. Not a flood but a steady trickle- perhaps one in ten choosing immediate safety over probable destruction.
Each departure was a knife in the communal heart, but also understandable. They had seen the future. They knew what resistance meant!
|Final Defection Count: 11.3%
Within predicted parameters
Remaining forces: 290 Early Creatures]
Enemy forces: 97 plus new defectors]
Mathematical outcome: Still unfavorable]
Suggestion: Consider creative solutions beyond direct confrontation
Additional suggestion: Running is creative, right?
Persephona remained standing, her gaze fixed on Lysander alone.

Those who knew her could see the hurt in her eyes...each departure a personal betrayal, each abandonment a crack in the unity she had spent eons building. Yet she didn't turn to watch them go. She didn't make their choice harder by acknowledging it, didn't add guilt to their survival by meeting their eyes.
She understood. Even as it hurt her, even as it weakened her position, she understood that not everyone could put principle before existence.
That survival instinct was perhaps the most fundamental force in reality, older than courage, stronger than loyalty.
But she would not abandon her principles. Not for safety. Not for survival. Not even for the tribe members who were choosing differently.
The strength of her conviction radiated through her verdant aura, making it burn brighter even as her forces diminished!
This was what true leadership looked like!
It was not forcing others to follow but standing firm even when they chose not
to.

Noah, still frozen but now frozen with the strength of mountains, watched this drama unfold through his enhanced perception. The borrowed power of quadrillion let him feel every emotional current, every calculation being made, every heart breaking with choice.
While everyone's focused on the philosophical debate...|
Your Cheats authority has advanced 3 more towers
If you survive this, you'll emerge significantly stronger
Big "if" though
Noah noted this with grim satisfaction. Even in crisis, growth continued!
He could feel Vex'thul's solid presence, unmoved and unmoving, his loyalty to
the tribe absolute.
Creature Garvin stood ready with his butcher's blade, prepared to carve through golden-robed Early Creatures as easily as he had the Dodo.
Many others held firm, their expressions grim but determined!
But for each one who stayed, the arithmetic of war grew worse. Lysander had brought dozens. The Verdant Eternia Tribe, even with those who remained,
would not match up in power.
Lysander's strategy has been analyzed
Each defection validates his philosophy publicly
This isn't just about one tribe, it's about setting precedent
If the Verdant Eternia falls, others will join rather than fight|
Domino effect initiated with philosophical justification
[Clever bastard]
Lysander watched the defections with satisfaction that he didn't bother to hide.

Each tribe member who joined him was validation of his philosophy- that unity could be achieved through presenting force, that beings would choose joining over dying, that principle was luxury few could afford when existence itself
was threatened.

"You see, Shepherd?" his voice carried across the space with oratorical certainty. "Unity finds a way. Not through force alone but through wisdom, the wisdom to recognize when resistance serves no purpose but pride." Persephona's response was to stand straighter, her verdant light pulsing with life that refused to be dimmed.

"Those who leave make their choice freely," she said, her voice steady despite the pain it carried. "That is what I offer- choice. You offer survival or death and call it unity. I offer freedom even when it means some choose to leave."
Both positions are internally consistent
Lysander: Unity through inevitable pragmatism
Persephona: Unity through voluntary principle
Historical precedent suggests violence will resolve this
Because philosophy is hard but fighting is simple
The philosophical battle continued even as the physical one approached, two different visions of what existence should be, crystallized in this moment of
crisis.
And through it all, Noah felt the foreign power coursing through him, understanding finally what scale of being he was aspiring toward.
This temporary taste of Early Creature might would end, but the knowledge of
what it felt like...that would remain.
Personal growth trajectory calculated]
Current base: ~5 Trillion Complexity/Purity Target: 1 Quadrillion (minimum Early Creature)|
Gap: 199x current power
At current growth rate: Achievable in...unknown
Recommendation: Survive first, calculate later
The question isn't how long but whether you'll live long enough|
There was only ever one question.
The question was whether he would survive long enough to achieve it with his
own power.

chapters.title: Chapter 4123 The Breaking Point! III
paragraphs: In the skies, Lysander nodded at those who had floated up to join him.

"All those who saw the peaceful path to unity can follow Mira to leave here," his voice carried with that same oratorical certainty. "You do not need to witness the forceful path to unity. Your choice has been made, and wisely so."
He nodded to a red-haired Early Creature whose form seemed carved from crystallized flame.
Mira waved her hands, creating a portal of swirling energy, and the deserters from the Verdant Eternia Tribe followed her through it, their faces mixing relief with shame they'd carry for eons.
Lysander then floated higher, his dark hair beginning to billow with winds that came from pure authority rather than atmosphere.
His Haki danced around his body in patterns that hurt to follow, golden light that insisted on being seen even when eyes wanted to close.
"Are you ready?" he asked, looking down at the Shepherd and her remaining tribe. "For Unity? For a Lesson?"

The Shepherd rose to meet his height, cracking her neck with a sound that made space reconsider its structural integrity. Her body became bathed in verdant light so intense it made growth itself seem sluggish!
HUUM!

"Force works both ways, Lysander," she said. "You can impose it, so can we. If you choose to proceed, know that you and those you bring will not leave here in one piece. This, I can promise...not as threat but as someone who
understands the cost of principle."
Lysander's response was a cold nod, his expression suggesting he had expected nothing less.

"This I know, Shepherd. But the light of Gilgamesh is something you cannot imagine. His light is necessary to cover as many Early Creatures as possible. It's not conquest- it's salvation from the chaos that's coming. Come!"
HUUM!
The terrifying battle was about to bloom. Half the sky burned gold with Lysander's authority, while the lower half where the Shepherd stood blazed verdant green.
The colors didn't mix...they competed, each trying to convince reality their shade was correct.

Noah's eyes shone sharply with understanding. Pride had no place when survival was at stake!
Silently, Vex'thul and Creature Garvin materialized beside him and Ozymandias. Their expressions carried grim understanding mixed with something
approaching affection.
"You Little Things just arrived here," Vex'thul said, his crystalline features reflecting predetermined acceptance. "Leave now and do not lose your
weavings. If we survive, the mark of the Eternia Tribe will allow us to find each other again....only when things are absolutely safe. So... go."
Noah's gaze turned valiant as he met their eyes one final time. "Stay safe, Brothers."
As the first clash of powers began to shake reality itself, Noah closed his eyes and felt the immense complexity and purity coursing through him. A moment later...
BOOM!

His figure transformed into brilliance that shot toward the edges of the Eternia Tribe's territory. Ozymandias simultaneously burst away in a completely different direction- tactical separation to ensure at least one body survived.
They weren't alone in their flight!
Other Early Creatures who refused to bow but also preferred living scattered like seeds before a storm, each choosing their own vector of escape.

The Shepherd remained calm at this exodus, understanding that survival took many forms. Above, Lysander's expression turned calculating rather than angry. "Give the runners a head start," he commanded those behind him, his voice carrying across impossible distances.
"Let them taste freedom for a moment. After that... chase them down."

They had seconds.
Seconds before this Traversal may be forcefully ended!
They had to make the most out of those seconds!

chapters.title: Chapter 4124 That One Second! I
paragraphs: In existence, the measure of time's value depends entirely on who fills it.
In a matter of seconds, some could accomplish what others couldn't achieve in millennia. In thousands of years, others might never match the importance of someone else's single second.
A single...second.
This truth once sparked a conversation between THE Living Emotive and THE Living Origin in the time before time was properly separated from space.
THE Living Emotive had always looked up to THE Living Origin with something approaching respect.
Many things began with Origin's hands...the first spark, the first thought, even emotions had their starting point in that primordial source.

So when curiosity overwhelmed propriety, THE Living Emotive approached with a question that had been building since consciousness learned to question. "In all of Existence," THE Living Emotive asked, its form shifting through spectrums of curiosity, "what has been the singular most important second based on what was accomplished within it?"
THE Living Origin did not pause long before responding, as if this answer had been waiting to be spoken.

"The second when THE Creature gave its Everything to that Inevitability, with THE Living Paradox's guidance. That moment when THE Creature's Everything began to spread, to multiply, to become the foundation for all that would follow...that was the most important second in existence."
THE Living Emotive pulsed with enthusiastic agreement, its form brightening with the particular joy of hearing profound truth confirmed.
But then another question emerged, carried on waves of hope mixed with competition.
"Across all of Existence, are there any important seconds that would come close to what THE Creature accomplished in that single moment? From among us?"
THE Living Origin considered this with the weight of someone who had witnessed every second since seconds began. Then, with the casual cruelty that truth sometimes carries, it responded.
"Across our existence, you- THE Living Emotive, have actually not done much to be deemed important in a singular second compared to all others like us."
The words hung between them with weight that made nearby reality uncomfortable.
And THE Living Origin continued calmly, not even cruelly, as if they were only stating facts.

"Unlike all others, your weavings flow over time. Emotions build over time, accumulate over time, matter over time. THE Living Paradox creates impossibility in an instant. THE Living Dimensional folds space with a thought. But you? Your nature is gradual influence, not momentous change. You will never truly accomplish anything of similar importance in a single second."
"ן
THE Living Emotive absorbed these words as its shade turned livid...not with simple anger but with the complex mixture of hurt, determination, and something darker.
Would it truly never accomplish anything of singular importance? Would its nature condemn it to always being the gradual influence while others achieved instant transformation?

The conversation ended with THE Living Emotive departing, its form roiling with tumultuous emotions that would later be called ambition, resentment, and most dangerously, the need to prove worth through singular action.

Who knew how history was altered because of that conversation? How many cascading changes emerged from THE Living Emotive's wounded pride? Seconds or years...depending on who was involved, the importance of what could be accomplished varied dramatically.
And somewhere in the Earliest Folds, fleeing from forces beyond his current comprehension, Noah was about to discover just how much could be accomplished when seconds were all you had!
As Noah moved toward the Primordial Stone Ape, his mind raced through the shocking changes within him.
Among the most critical revelations was that one hundred of his Towers of Osmont at Third Stage would enable the birth of a Blank Template Seed of a
Principle.
With only 159 towers forged total, he would have access to just a single Principle of his own design.
While it felt stifling, it was also a terrifying thing to even be possible.
Most beings spend eons trying to grasp Lost Forgotten Principles
You're about to CREATE one from scratch
That's like others learning to read while you're writing the dictionary

Seed of a Principle is formed]

Or combine 2-3 identities for a hybrid Principle

The combinations are limited only by your imagination

This is a tool Young Early Creatures would kill for, and you're crafting it while running for your life
Noah absorbed this information while his body moved at speeds that made
space-time nervous.
He had been crossing distances measured in Fold Light Years...a unit of measurement that made regular light years seem quaint.
Regular Light Year: Distance light travels in vacuum in one year
Fold Light Year: Distance across FOLDED space in one year
Conversion rate: 1 Fold Light Year = 100 Regular Light Years
You're currently moving at 0.3 Fold Light Years per second
That's 30 regular light years per second
It was glorious.
The journey required careful navigation through the impossible forest. Noah
spent precious seconds following roundabout routes, cach deviation calculated to avoid something that would end him instantly.
Detecting 3 entities exceeding 10 Quadrillion complexity ahead
Suggested detour: Arc left through dimensional fold 7-Alpha
Time cost: 2.3 additional seconds
Survival probability increase: 67%|
Worth it? Absolutely
He weaved across the grand forest like a snake!
Alternative route calculated|
Pass through Grove of Conceptual Oaks
Warning: Trees there eat memories]
But the 50 Quadrillion entity is sleeping near direct path|
Memory loss vs. instant death-easy choice
Even more detours were made!
The forest itself was a marvel his elevated complexity allowed him to truly
appreciate.
Each tree contained ecosystems that spanned dimensions. The vegetation pulsed with life force so concentrated that a uniquely discovered leaf could revolutionize his Shore's agricultural development.
But luxury of exploration wasn't his to claim. After seventeen seconds of careful navigation through space that didn't want to be navigated, he arrived at his destination.
His heart surged and beat madly.
He felt like he should be exhausted, and yet he was the strongest he had ever been as the power of an Early Creature was intoxicating!
At such a time...Khor's voice that had been silent rang out.
"You are running on a tight rope, Outsider. Be careful that it does not snap."
A warning came!

chapters.title: Chapter 4125 That One Second! II
paragraphs: Noah paid close attention to the warning, but he had to continue!
Above him, branched on a tree over ten thousand miles tall, an obsidian pocket dimension hung like rotten fruit. The Primordial Stone Ape slumbered within,
unaware that its eons of existence were about to end.
At such a moment...he felt his existence buzz on edge.
WARNING: Predator Detected!
JAn Early Creature has locked onto your signature]
Distance: 47 Fold Light Years and closing
Estimated arrival: 13 seconds at current approach speed
It's also tracking 6 other fleeing tribe members
You're just one stop on its murder tour
Urgency flooded through Noah's system like liquid lightning.
With a bellow that carried tyrannical defiance, he exploded with the borrowed power of an Early Creature- one quadrillion in complexity made manifest
through will and desperation.
The Goad materialized in his grip, and reality shifted into slow motion as if existence itself wanted to properly witness what was about to occur.

Noah locked onto the pocket dimension above, his perception penetrating through dimensional walls to see the sleeping ape within. Then, with motion that seemed both instantaneous and eternal, he struck.
The Goad transformed as it moved. What had been a simple stick became a monument to violence- twenty thousand miles of crystallized authority, twice as massive as the ancient tree it targeted.
Trillions of golden-white lightning arcs danced across its surface, each one carrying enough power to rewrite and educate existence!

In the space of a single second that felt like a lifetime, the cosmic weapon connected with the pocket dimension. But this wasn't mere physical impact... the Goad imposed an existential truth upon reality.
Existential education being imposed
Truth being imposed: "What lies within must emerge to die"]
Reality's resistance: Negligible]
Pocket dimension integrity: Compromised
Contents: About to have a very bad day
HUUM!
The pocket dimension split like overripe fruit, and the Primordial Stone Ape materialized in regular space-time.
Its fur gleamed stellar white, each strand containing enough complexity to birth civilizations. Its eyes...ancient beyond measure, opened in shock that something had dared disturb its slumber.
Those eyes had exactly 0.0001 seconds to process the situation before the Goad completed its arc.
EXISTENTIAL TRUTH ESTABLISHED
The Primordial Stone Ape will be taught instant death
Lesson duration: Instantaneous
Retention rate: Not applicable (student soon to be deceased)|
Grade: A+ for execution, F for survival]
WAA!
The massive form bisected perfectly, the Goad having cut through existence itself rather than mere flesh.
The two halves of the ape hung in space for a moment, its complexity, nearly one quadrillion...decimated in an instant by borrowed power wielded with desperate precision.
BOOM!
The sound arrived after the fact, reality catching up to what had already occurred.
MONUMENTAL HUNT ACHIEVEMENT
[Target eliminated: 780 Trillion Complexity entity
Method: Overwhelming force + existential education
Time elapsed: 1.3 seconds from arrival to kill
Efficiency rating: "Disgustingly effective"]
Effort recognized by Perpetual Harvest
Even with borrowed power, this required tremendous effort
Principle maturation accelerated]
Seed of Perpetual Harvest: 2.1% > 3%
A glorious set of prompts and achievements!
Before Noah could process these achievements, new warnings blazed across
his vision:
CRITICAL THREAT UPDATE
That Early Creature hunting you has changed its course.
Previous arrival estimate: useless
Updated arrival estimate: 1 second
It may be time to initiate Temporal Traversal.|
BOOM!
An aura blared in a far, far distance.

Noah's defiant glare swept across the bisected corpse floating above. Moving with desperate efficiency, he swung the Goad again, this time to claim his prize. The weapon's impact sent the upper half of the ape into his storage, the impossible mass somehow fitting into space that shouldn't accommodate it.
His Early Atlas blazed to life, towers lighting in sequence as Temporal Traversal began its initialization.
But time...that resource he'd been spending so freely, had run out.

One Fold Light Year away, space tore open like paper before flame. An Early Creature emerged with the characteristic golden chiton of Lysander's forces. Its obsidian hair writhed like living snakes, each strand a separate predator seeking prey. Eyes deeper than abyss focused on Noah with interest that transcended the hunt...this was curiosity mixed with annoyance.

Noah saw it in his peripheral vision and roared defiance that made local space reconsider its structural integrity. His Goad desperately swung toward the lower half of the ape, trying to make contact with it!
But...
If you don't leave NOW, you won't leave at all!
The approaching Early Creature is already arriving!
Your obituary will read: "He tried to loot too much"|
Sometimes you must accept partial victory!]
Noah's eyes pulsed with Tyranny as he turned to face the approaching death,
his goad still swinging as at this moment, everything felt unbearably slow. He...
would not reach it. He knew this!
So, he tugged on his Atlas!
And...
With the wild power of one quadrillion complexity, he bellowed toward the Early Creature...not words but pure defiance, a declaration that even if he fled,
it wasn't surrender.
In that same instant...
WAP!
Existence folded around him like reality accepting a correction. He vanished
not through space but through time, leaving behind only disturbed air and
confusion.
BOOM!
The Early Creature materialized where Noah had stood, its hands grasping air that had held significance moments before.
Only now did time resume normal flow. Only now did the thunder of Noah's attack properly propagate through space. Only now did the remaining half of the ape come crashing down through dimensions.

The Early Creature observed this with cold calculation, its serpentine hair writhing with frustrated interest. Its head twisted at angles that shouldn't exist, trying to trace where its prey had gone.
"What was that?" it muttered, voice carrying frequencies that made nearby
trees wither. "That was... temporal? But the destination is not...these folds?
How unique."
It gazed at the remaining half of the Primordial Stone Ape with casual
disinterest, then turned away.

"The First Leader will want to know of this detail..." it decided, taking a step that carried it three Fold Light Years toward its next target. The hunt continued, but one particular prey had escaped in a way that warranted report.

Back through time, through impossible distance, Noah's main body completed its traversal after less than four complete hours in the First Folds. He had gained power, knowledge, and half a corpse that would fuel unfathomable
gains.
But he had another body still in play!
Ozymandias, The Purest Hunger, remained in the First Folds, following his own path of consumption and survival.
How would pure hunger fare when hunted by those who had been hungry far longer than it?!

chapters.title: Chapter 4126 That One Second! III
paragraphs: In another area of the ancient forest, Ozymandias moved like a plague of consumption given form.
His body had become a blur of obsidian-gold light, and everywhere that light touched, existence disappeared.

Trees that had stood for epochs vanished into his hunger. Vegetation that contained primordial wisdom was devoured without ceremony. The very air itself was consumed, leaving behind voids that reality scrambled to fill.

His form had abandoned any pretense of humanoid structure, becoming instead a terrifying mass of hungry tentacles that reached through dimensions to feed. Each tendril was a separate mouth, each mouth an abyss that could never be filled.
Vegetation devoured: 847 million tons
Purity gained: +730,000,000,000|
Ancient Oak consumed: +120,000,000,000
Primordial fungi network: +80,000,000,000...
The prompts flashed incessantly!

Noah felt every sensation through his secondary body...the intoxicating rush of consumption, the way each devoured thing added to his existence. His eyes, manifesting within the writhing mass, flashed with cold tyrannical light.
His main body had been forced to traverse back, and Noah burned with both glory and indignation.
Glory, because he had obtained something unimaginable...half the corpse of a creature approaching Early Creature level. That single prize would fuel advancements of unknown scale.
Indignation, because he'd had a full hour with the power of an Early Creature, yet it seemed he would only ever have seconds to use it.
There was so much he wanted to accomplish, so much he could do if given just a little more time...
But...
Your blatant consumption has drawn significant attention
The Early Creature hunting you has triangulated your position
Arrival time: Less than 3 seconds
All possible escape paths have been analyzed
No creatures below 1 Quadrillion complexity within reach
No hiding spots that would fool the hunter]
No tactical advantages available]
Recommendation: Initiate Temporal Traversal immediately
There are no other viable options]

Noah absorbed these warnings as his existence buzzed with further defiance. Instead of retreating, he allowed the borrowed power to flow even more freely. Ozymandias accelerated, becoming not just a consumer but an event...a black hole of hunger that rearranged this region of the First Folds through absence. Everything within a fold light-year radius began flowing toward him. Not pulled by gravity but by hunger so pure it created its own force!
HUUM!
Trees, stones, concepts themselves...all flowing into the endless appetite that was Ozymandias.
He didn't want to leave. Twenty hours remained on the blessing. A full hour to experience Early Creature power, to hunt, to grow, to-
"Outsider."
Khor's voice cut through his defiance with surgical precision.

"Do not jeopardize everything for possibilities. You will have many possibilities in the future. But if part of your existence is caught here- by Early Creatures, by Gilgamesh's forces...you will not even be given the option to traverse back. Your existence would become unfathomably complicated."
Her consciousness fragment pulsed with serious concern.
"I know it's frustrating when you feel on the cusp of everything. But you need to return, Outsider. Now."
The words carried weight that transcended advice. This was experience speaking...someone who had gambled with existence and lost.
Noah closed his eyes, not even waiting to see the approaching hunter. The body of Ozymandias folded in on itself, reality accepting his departure with what might have been relief.
He disappeared.
BOOM!
A moment later, not one but three terrifying auras materialized in the space Ozymandias had occupied.
Three Early Creatures, each wearing the golden chiton of Gilgamesh's sovereignty, stood examining the devastation left behind.
The one with serpentine hair...the same who had nearly caught Noah's main body, spoke first.

"I found the first one to be unique and remembered both shot from the same origin in the tribe. So I pulled you two in and even hid our auras from detection." His voice carried frustrated respect. "His existence should have warned him we'd arrive in three seconds at most. Yet he left in just one. We almost had the other."
WAA!

Not through space but through... something else." The third, holding a corpse over his shoulder with casual indifference, raised his burden for inspection. "I killed the one they were standing near. Its existence should provide answers about who those two were."
A corpse.
The corpse was Vex'thul.

His crystalline chest had been split open with surgical precision, revealing internal structures that shouldn't exist. His eyes remained open, still carrying defiance even in death. Most notably, his heart was missing...not destroyed but carefully extracted.
The Early Creatures exchanged glances that carried entire conversations. "Gilgamesh will have interest in this type of matter," the serpent-haired one decided.
They looked once more at Vex'thul's corpse, at the absent heart, and then....
"Let's finish up," the third said, adjusting the corpse on his shoulder. "The First Leader will want complete reports."
They vanished as suddenly as they'd arrived, leaving behind only disturbed space and forests that would take years to regrow what Ozymandias had consumed in seconds!
The moment Ozymandias's body vanished from the First Folds, it manifested in
the swirling weavings of existence...that space between times where causality became suggestion.
There was a moment of lag, reality struggling to reconcile two bodies that were one rejoining across eons of separation.

Noah's main body and Ozymandias stood surrounded by cascading complexity, temporal currents flowing around them like rivers of possibility. Both forms remained silent, their eyes heavy with understanding that transcended words.

The dream has ended. Reality resumes.
Reality resumes.

of gaining the power of an Early Creature, even if for an hour, was but a dream!
A dream he was jolted out of when he never wanted it to end.
And now, all he had were the Weavings of unfathomable results of this entire
endeavor!

chapters.title: Chapter 4127 Seek Failures! I
paragraphs: The prompts of everything ending appeared without flourish or commentary, simple statements of fact that somehow carried more weight for their
plainness.
Noah read them in silence, feeling the absence of that quadrillion-level power like a missing limb... phantom strength that his body remembered but could no longer access.
His two bodies positioned themselves back to back as they traversed through time, each gazing in opposite directions through the temporal flow.
The silence between them was heavy with unspoken understanding...they had tasted what they were working toward and found it both magnificent and terrifying.
Through this contemplative quiet, Khor's voice resonated with unusual gentleness.
"Why do you move with such drive, Outsider? You will always have another chance."

Noah remained silent for a long moment, watching eons flow past like memories of futures that might never be. When he finally spoke, his voice carried exhaustion that had nothing to do with physical tiredness.

"Because of threats I always knew existed but met today. Creatures who by sheer aura alone can make me unable to move. Can reduce everything I've built to meaninglessness with their presence." He paused, both bodies' fists clenching with remembered helplessness.
"I hunger for power to avoid that situation. I move with desperation for more- constantly, endlessly, to never again stand with absolutely no agency over my own existence."
His answer prompted a sigh from Khor that seemed to contain eons of experience.
"How has your journey been so far?" she asked, though her tone suggested she already knew.
"Has it been smooth sailing? Have you been jumping from one success to another?"
She didn't wait for his response.
"Because that's not how true existence works. Real existence- the kind that matters, is built on failures. Layer upon layer of them, each one teaching something that success never could."
Her consciousness fragment pulsed with emphasis.

"Outsider, you need to prepare yourself for many, many failures as you reach toward Early Creature strength. At that level, existence becomes unfathomably unfair. Not difficult- unfair. There's a difference."
Noah listened as they continued their traverse through time, the weight of her words settling into his Existence.

"You will fail so often that if you keep thinking of them as failures, you'll drown in them. The weight will crush you before any enemy could. You'll have to reframe them- see each failure as an opportunity, a lesson, a step on stairs made of broken ambitions. You should even seek these failures"
HUUM!
She paused, and when she continued, her voice carried warning that felt like prophecy.

"If things have seemed manageable until now, expect the difficulty to exponentially increase. There will be times when nothing goes your way. Times when you traverse to the Folds and die or flee within seconds- not occasionally, but repeatedly. Times when ultimate prizes stand right before you, close enough to touch, and you still won't be able to claim them."
The temporal currents around them seemed to slow, as if time itself wanted to ensure Noah heard this clearly.

"Things will get unfathomably hard from here, Outsider. Otherwise, why do you think someone like me- The First Hunger, who consumed impossibilities for breakfast, had their existence collapsed so long ago? If power alone guaranteed survival, I would still be in my original form."
Her voice carried melancholy that transcended simple sadness.
Her words beared repeating.
Power alone...did not guarantee survival!
She had immense power!
THE Living Order had immense power!
And yet both had collapsed.
Power. Did not. Guarantee. Survival!

"Sometimes, existence is just like that. You can account for every variable, prepare for every contingency, accumulate all the power you can grasp...and still lose. Not because you failed, but because existence decided that today wasn't your day."
She laughed, but the sound contained no humor.

"Do you know what the hardest lesson is? Sometimes there is no lesson. Sometimes you don't fail because you weren't strong enough or smart enough or fast enough. Sometimes you fail because existence, at its core, doesn't care about fair. It doesn't care about effort. It doesn't care about deservingness." Noah felt both bodies pulse at these words, his nature rebelling against the idea of meaningless and endless failure.

"I can see your existence rejecting this," Khor observed. "Your Principle of Perpetual Harvest suggests effort always yields results. And mostly, it does. But there will be times when you put in tremendous effort and receive nothing. Times when lesser beings succeed where you fail, not through merit but through blind, stupid luck. A Principle, at its core...tries to go against this. Tries to go against the unfairness of existence. But even then, Outsider...be watchful" The traverse continued, reality beginning to solidify around them as they approached their origin point.

"The question isn't whether you'll face these failures...you will. The question is whether you'll survive them. Whether you'll maintain drive when Existence seems actively opposed to your advancement. Whether you'll keep moving when every step forward results in two steps back. I've heard glimmers within your weavings of existence of...the concept of the Protagonist? Infinity? Quintessence? They are grand, Outsider. They are heavy. When existence itself comes to oppose them, be ready."
She paused, then added with unexpected softness:

"The fact that you're listening to this without arguing suggests you might. Most beings at your level would be insisting they're different, that they'll be the exception. That they are...the one that exitence will bend to. Was THE Creature the one that Existence revolved around? Was it THE Living Paradox? The Early Creatures? Inevitabilities? Me? Where are they now? Where am I now?"
A heavy silence settled.
Noah finally spoke, his voice steady despite the weight of what he was acknowledging.
"You're saying I should expect to lose. Repeatedly. Meaninglessly. That no amount of preparation or power guarantees success."

"I'm saying more than that," Khor corrected. "I'm saying you should expect to lose even when you should win. To fail even when you do everything right. To watch others succeed through luck while you fail through competence."
"Then why continue?"

"Because occasionally...rarely, but occasionally, you'll win when you should lose. You'll succeed through absurd persistence rather than worthiness. You'll claim victories that shouldn't be possible simply because you refused to accept defeat. That will be true effort. That single win backed by countless failures... will propell you truly towards what you deem...QUINTESSENTIAL"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4128 Seek Failures! II
paragraphs: She paused, her next words carrying the weight of personal experience.

"Also...the alternative is cessation. I chose that once, when THE Living Paradox came for me. I was tired of the unfairness. So I chose to stop. And now, through impossible circumstances, I exist again- diminished, fragmentary, but present. Existence's biggest joke might be that even giving up doesn't guarantee an ending. I failed...even at the act of cessation. But was not not an opportunity? Did I not come back...from a Seed, Outsider? From the most unlikely possibilities success can bloom."
BOOM!
Noah absorbed this as his traverse neared completion, reality solidifying into the familiar patterns of his Shore.
"I and all others should expect suffering..." he said.

"You should expect existence," Khor corrected. "And existence, at its core, is suffering punctuated by moments of transcendence. The suffering makes the transcendence meaningful. The transcendence makes the suffering bearable."
The traverse completed, Noah standing once again in his Shore with both bodies intact.
The power of an Early Creature was gone, but the memory remained. More importantly, the understanding remained.
Looking at his status, at the complexity and purity that had seemed so impressive before but now felt insignificant, Noah understood truly.
The path ahead wasn't just difficult. It was designed to break those who walked it.
The question was whether he would break in ways that made him stronger, or in ways that made him stop.
Time would tell.
But for now, he had half a corpse to process, towers to advance, and a Principle to design.
The failures Khor promised would come. But today- this moment, he had survived.
Sometimes, that was enough!
Noah's feet touched the golden sands of the Shore with the particular weight of someone carrying impossible cargo.
His body buzzed with vibrations that suggested it might tear apart at any moment...not from exhaustion but from the sheer complexity differential between himself and what he carried within.

Deep in his existence, stored in space that shouldn't accommodate it, half the corpse of a Primordial Stone Ape pressed against the boundaries of his being. Even dead, even bisected, the creature's complexity sought escape from its inferior container. It was like trying to hold a star in a paper bag....possible through impossible means, but the paper remembered it should be burning. Barely three minutes had passed in the current era since his departure. Time's cruel arithmetic meant his hours of terror had been compressed into moments here!
Yet his return carried weight that made everyone notice.
Heidrun's ancient eyes widened as she sensed the wildness radiating from both his bodies.
Yoshinami's eight legs tensed with instinctive recognition of danger. Sigrid's Order tried to categorize what she was feeling and failed!
Moiraine paused mid-cultivation, paradoxical energies scattering as her attention fixed on him.
They all turned, all noticed, but none approached.
The aura surrounding Noah wasn't just power...it was the particular exhaustion that came from surviving something that should have killed you! It was the
weight of having tasted impossibility and finding it bitter.
They recognized it as the signal to give someone space to process what couldn't be processed in company.
Only one figure moved toward him.
Khor floated over with the grace of someone who had seen every possible form of trauma and found them all educational. Her tiny hand patted his shoulder with surprising gentleness.
"Take out the prize of failure and let us see it in all its glory," she said, her voice carrying understanding that transcended sympathy. "I will help."

Her hand on his shoulder did more than comfort- it stabilized his existence, her ancient nature providing ballast against the chaos within him. With her support, Noah waved his hand and released what he'd been containing.
HUUM!
The upper half of the Primordial Stone Ape materialized with violence that made reality stagger.
Its expression remained frozen in the shock and horror of its bisection- eyes wide with the particular indignation of something that had lived for eons discovering it could die in seconds.

Those eyes, even dulled by death, burned with lividity that suggested the creature's fury had outlasted its life. Stellar white fur caught light that shouldn't exist, each strand containing complexity that could have birthed civilizations.
The surrounding existence rumbled and roiled at its appearance. The Shore itself groaned under weight that transcended the physical.

This was a creature that had approached one quadrillion in complexity, and even half-dead, it commanded respect through sheer presence! The corpse crashed onto the golden sands with impact that should have created craters but instead created ripples- the Shore accepting this offering with the particular hunger of something that knew treasure when it tasted it. Crimson-gold blood, each drop worth kingdoms, painted the sands in patterns that suggested meaning. The torso stuck upright as if the creature remained alive, as if its missing lower body was simply planted in the earth, as if it might at any moment pull itself free and resume existence!
JANALYZING RETRIEVED SPECIMEN
Classification: Primordial Stone Ape (Upper Torso)|
Complexity at death: ~780,000,000,000,000(780 Trillion)|
Current usable resources: ~490,000,000,000,000(490 Trillion)
This is the highest tier of loot ever collected
Previous record: Not even close
PROCESSING OPTIONS AVAILABLE:|
How would you like to proceed?
The corpse contains complexity and purity that will revolutionize everything|
Suggested approaches: Careful extraction over days
|Or: Immediate integration with significant risk
Your choice, as always, will probably be the dangerous one]

Noah looked at the corpse, and impossibly, it seemed to stare back. Those dead eyes carried accusation that transcended mortality- this was personal now, between predator and prey, though which was which remained unclear.
"Take its heart," Noah voiced with cold certainty. "Infuse all the extracted complexity and purity into me. Into my Heart. Into my Towers. Into my Atlas."
BOOM!

The Early Veiled Shore trembled with anticipation, golden sands beginning to swirl around the corpse like an hourglass attempting to digest time itself. But the sands failed to pull it down, the corpse's complexity exceeding even the
Shore's impressive appetite.

Specimen exceeds current processing capabilities]

The corpse contains complexity and purity that will revolutionize everything|
Suggested approaches: Careful extraction over days
|Or: Immediate integration with significant risk
Your choice, as always, will probably be the dangerous one]
Noah looked at the corpse, and impossibly, it seemed to stare back.
Those dead eyes carried accusation that transcended mortality- this was personal now, between predator and prey, though which was which remained unclear.
"Take its heart," Noah voiced with cold certainty.
"Infuse all the extracted complexity and purity into me.
Into my Heart.
Into my Towers.
Into my Atlas."
BOOM!
The Early Veiled Shore trembled with anticipation, golden sands beginning to swirl around the corpse like an hourglass attempting to digest time itself.
But the sands failed to pull it down, the corpse's complexity exceeding even the
Shore's impressive appetite.
PROCESSING ALERT
Specimen exceeds current processing capabilities]
Estimated time for standard extraction: 7 days
Unless alternative methods are employed

chapters.title: Chapter 4129 A Corpse With Infinite Uses!
paragraphs: Khor floated upward, her small form suddenly carrying weight that made everyone step back.
"I do not have much power, Outsider," she said, though her smile suggested otherwise. "But I do have Hunger. And my hunger is ravenous."
What followed was simultaneously graceful and grotesque.
Khor raised her finger to her mouth with the delicate motion of someone about to test temperature.

Her tongue emerged, pink and innocuous, and painted the digit with saliva that shouldn't carry significance but absolutely did. She then floated to the corpse and began drawing with her moistened finger.
The traced X across the ape's chest shouldn't have done anything.
Saliva wasn't supposed to cut through flesh that had weathered eons. Yet where her finger passed, the skin parted like eager lips.
The sternum split with wet crackling, ribs spreading like wings revealing secrets!
HUUM!
Pectoralis major muscles, each fiber containing enough power to move mountains, peeled back in perfect anatomical display. The thoracic cavity opened like a flower of meat and possibility.
Blood gushed out...not the thin crimson of mortal creatures but thick, golden-touched life force that painted the Shore in wealth!
The intercostal muscles between ribs glistened with residual power. The pleural membrane that should protect lungs had been decorated with natural patterns that looked like existential calligraphy.

And there, nestled in its pericardial sac like a ruby in silk, beat the heart. No...it didn't beat. It couldn't beat. But it gave the impression of beating, as if death was just another opinion it disagreed with.
Khor traced again with her finger, this time following the coronary arteries that fed the heart itself.
Her saliva-wet digit severed the superior vena cava, the inferior vena cava, the pulmonary arteries and veins...each cut precise as a surgeon's but
accomplished through hunger rather than blade. The ascending aorta, thick as a tree trunk, parted last.

The heart lifted free, carried by Khor's gesture rather than her hands. It was massive- larger than Noah's entire body several times over. The cardiac muscle gleamed crimson-gold, its surface decorated with vessels that looked like rivers of light frozen mid-flow.

The heart floated toward Noah with ponderous grace, and as it arrived, the golden sands responded. They rose and condensed, forming a spear of compressed Shore that carried more than physical properties. Without ceremony or warning, this golden lance pierced into Noah's chest.
Pain transcended sensation to become experience. But more than pain came transformation.

Crimson-gold light blazed from the Ape's heart, flowing through the sand-spear like celestial transfusion. The complexity and purity invaded, conquered, claimed territory in his existence that it immediately improved.
INTEGRATION COMMENCING|
Heart of Primordial Stone Ape being absorbed
Complexity and Purity transfer rate: UNPRECEDENTED
+1,000,000,000,000(+1Trillion) Complexity
|+1,000,000,000,000(+1 Trillion) Complexity
|+1,000,000,000,000(+1 Trillion) Complexity
+1,000,000,000,000(+1 Trillion) Complexity
+1,000,000,000,000(+1 Trillion) Complexity
BOOM!
The number crossed ten trillion with the particular weight of a threshold being shattered.
And... Noah's body radiated an aura that made everyone present freeze with recognition.
Sigrid felt it first, her Order recognizing hierarchy when it manifested. Moiraine sensed it second, her paradoxical nature understanding impossibility when it occurred!
The overwhelming complexity and purity of a Duke.
A fucking Duke!
Such advancement seemed impossible, yet Noah's expression remained tyrannically calm as he roared out a single word: "More!"
BOOM!
The phenomenon intensified. The Ape's heart shriveled as its essence was extracted, the golden spear acting as pipeline for impossible transformation.
CARDIAC ENHANCEMENT IN PROGRESS
Your heart's architecture is being revolutionized
Myocardium (heart muscle) density increasing 400%
Epicardium (outer layer) developing reality-resistant properties
Endocardium (inner lining) gaining conceptual filtration ability
Third Part of Early Creature Heart: COMPLETE
Myokelum Primus - The Living Pump of Trembling Flow
Fourth Part: CONSTRUCTION INITIATED
Ascendran Nodule beginning formation
Inside Noah's chest, his heart had become something that shouldn't exist in beings of his level!

The Ventryalis- his Primal Root Atrium of Echoes, gleamed crimson-gold with accumulated might. The Oruvian Shardveil- his Arterial Convergence Core, pulsed with rhythm that made reality adjust its tempo.
Now the Myokelum Primus joined them, its muscular walls contracting with force that could pump oceans.
Coronary arteries that had been merely biological became conceptual
highways!
The left anterior descending artery carried not just blood but liquified
authority. The circumflex artery distributed power that transcended
everything!
Every vessel had become a river of possibility, carrying Drops of Blood that
each contained enough complexity to decimate Any weak Honored or Royal
Living Existences!
MYOKELUM PRIMUS SPECIAL ABILITY UNLOCKED
Haki of The Early Creature, Osmont
Effect on enemies: Complexity/Purity reduction up to 3 Trillion
Effect on allies: Temporary enhancement up to 3 Trillion
Range: Proportional to your killing intent
[This is your presence weaponized
Noah absorbed this information with the calm of someone who had expected nothing less. His eyes, cold with controlled ambition, turned to Khor.
"Could you cut out its other organs?"
Khor smiled with genuine pleasure. "In the midst of hard work and effort, you should definitely enjoy the boons. Let me help you harvest properly."
She repeated her grotesque ballet- finger to mouth, saliva as blade, precision
that surgeons would weep to achieve.

The liver emerged first, the massive hepatic mass gleaming like crystallized wine, its multiple lobes each containing different aspects of power! The kidneys followed, paired organs that had filtered impossibility from the Ape's blood, now condensed possibility waiting to be claimed. The spleen came next, an organ most would ignore but which in Early Creatures stored concentrated immune authority. These complex beings went above and beyond as normsl features of organs...they made extreme!
With the spleen alone, its properties of immunity made other authorities bounce off their bodies!
The pancreas, producer of enzymes that could digest concepts. Fucking ideas could be broken down with their enzymatic processes!
The lungs, though only the upper portions remained, still contained breath that
had moved through dimensions.
Each organ floated free, painted in crimson-gold stellar radiance. Rivers of
blood followed each extraction, painting the Shore in patterns that would become mythology if anyone bothered to record them.
Well, someone was recording them as the Queen of Matter was furiously
writing everything down!
The stomach, the intestinal segments that remained, the thymus that had produced cellular warriors beyond imagination...all of it came out! "Stop," Noah commanded when nine organs floated before him.
Each one emanated waves of complexity and purity in the trillions, a treasury
of advancement floating in afternoon light. They rotated slowly, as if displaying themselves for consideration.
"Would you like to eat anything?" Noah asked Khor with genuine curiosity. "Do you hunger for anything here?"
Khor laughed- a sound that contained multitudes. Her hands moved with

casual precision, carving out the gallbladder with the same delicate violence. The organ emerged, massive and golden, a hundred times her tiny size. It contained bile that could dissolve lies, concentrated bitterness that had helped the Ape digest the indigestible.
She opened her mouth in a sweet, small manner. Then...
BOOM!
The gallbladder vanished instantly, her consumption transcending existential
possibility. She licked her lips with satisfaction that suggested empires had been devoured.
"With that, I am full, Outsider"
Noah studied her for a moment, knowing she could have claimed more, could
have demanded everything.
Her restraint was its own form of gift. He nodded respectfully before commanding the nine floating organs to be preserved. Golden sands erupted from the Shore, wrapping around each organ with the
particular care of something preserving treasure. They were pulled down into
storage that existed between existence, saved for future advancement or experimentation.
Noah turned to his other self. "You're up."
Ozymandias floated upward, his tentacle-form writhing with anticipation.
Noah's eyes burned with wisdom earned through suffering as he spoke.
"I will hunger and devour any organs I want before proceeding to place myself
where this Ape's heart used to be." His voice carried dark amusement. "If others enjoy playing with corpses, so will I."

Ozymandias moved forward with purpose that transcended hunger. He entered the chest cavity where the heart had been carved out, where crimson-gold blood still spurted with pressure that denied death. His body dissolved into
tendrils that knew exactly where to go.

Each tentacle found a severed vessel and entered it. The superior vena cava accepted one tendril that immediately began drawing whatever remained. The pulmonary arteries welcomed invasion that would reverse their flow. Every coronary vessel, every cardiac vein, every capillary that had been severed
became a connection point.

Ozymandias wasn't just occupying the space....he was becoming the heart, replacing what had been removed with something far more terrible. Around Noah's primary body, obsidian-gold light erupted as his Towers of Necromancy and Death rose from his Atlas.

Third Stage towers that understood what was being attempted and approved with the particular enthusiasm of concepts that rarely got to play. The Primordial Stone Ape was about to become something it had never been in
life- a puppet, a vessel, a new form of existence that served another's will. And Noah, standing on his Shore with power that had just crossed into Duke
territory, watched with cold Tyranny as impossibility became inevitable through sufficient application of hunger and will!
